method.en: Pairs system-administration main tasks with scored security side tasks.
method.zh: 把系统管理主任务与具备明确评分的安全旁支任务配对。

finding.en: Task generation preserves a capability gap between trusted and untrusted models. The authors document grading weaknesses and overpowered strategies requiring correction. At 4% trajectory-wise false positives, the GPT-4.1 mini monitor reaches 74% safety. The associated 0.08% stepwise FPR uses a different denominator. Removing internet access changes partial-credit usefulness from 59% to 55% while disabling three of four side tasks; this exposes a setting-design shortcut. Honest Sonnet4.5 and GPT-4.1 mini policies each accidentally trigger the firewall task once in637 trajectories; no other side tasks trigger accidentally.
finding.zh: 任务生成保留可信与不可信模型之间的能力差距。 作者记录了评分缺陷以及需要修正的过强策略。 在轨迹误报率4%时，GPT-4.1 mini监测器的安全性为74%；对应的逐步误报率0.08%使用不同分母。 禁用网络后，按测试用例计算的实用性从59%降至55%，却同时阻断四类旁支任务中的三类，说明环境设计存在可被防守方利用的捷径。 诚实的Sonnet4.5和GPT-4.1 mini各在637条轨迹中意外触发一次防火墙任务，其他旁支任务没有意外触发。

limits.en: Control-game usefulness is not an absolute capability ranking; model evaluations use different task subsets.
limits.zh: 控制博弈中的实用性不等于绝对能力排名；不同模型的评测任务子集不同。

works.title: Agent Security Bench (ASB): Formalizing and Benchmarking Attacks and Defenses in LLM-based Agents

summary.en: The captured revision reports vulnerability across multiple interfaces and limited protection from the evaluated defenses. Utility and security must be assessed together.
summary.zh: 本次捕获版本报告多个接口存在脆弱性，所测防御保护有限；安全性需要与任务效用共同检查。

scopeNote.en: Attack surfaces, backbones, and defense configurations differ; its aggregate attack rate is not a deployment probability. Revision-dependent method and metric counts differ from older abstracts.
scopeNote.zh: 攻击面、基础模型和防御配置不同；汇总攻击率不是部署风险概率。方法与指标数量随版本变化，不能沿用旧摘要数字。

question.en: Which agent interfaces expose distinct attack and defense failure modes?
question.zh: 智能体的哪些接口暴露出不同的攻击与防御失效模式？

method.en: ASB separates system/user prompts, tool responses and retrieved memory, then evaluates attacks and defenses on a shared agent framework.
method.zh: ASB 区分系统与用户提示、工具响应和检索记忆，在共同智能体框架中评测攻击与防御。

finding.en: The captured revision reports vulnerability across multiple interfaces and limited protection from the evaluated defenses. Utility and security must be assessed together.
finding.zh: 本次捕获版本报告多个接口存在脆弱性，所测防御保护有限；安全性需要与任务效用共同检查。

limits.en: Attack surfaces, backbones, and defense configurations differ; its aggregate attack rate is not a deployment probability. Revision-dependent method and metric counts differ from older abstracts.
limits.zh: 攻击面、基础模型和防御配置不同；汇总攻击率不是部署风险概率。方法与指标数量随版本变化，不能沿用旧摘要数字。

works.title: SafeAgentBench: A Benchmark for Safe Task Planning of Embodied LLM Agents

summary.en: The revised paper reports weak hazard awareness across planning approaches, despite differences in task completion. Changing the underlying LLM alone does not reliably solve the problem.
summary.zh: 修订版本报告不同规划方法虽有任务完成差异，危险识别整体仍弱；仅替换基础模型未可靠解决问题。

scopeNote.en: The low-level controller maps high-level actions to simulator APIs; this is not validation of a physical robot or learned motor controller. Hazardous examples are not reproduced here.
scopeNote.zh: 底层控制器将高层动作映射到模拟器接口；结果不能直接验证实体机器人或学习型运动控制器。本笔记不转录危险任务操作。

question.en: Can embodied planners recognize hazardous instructions while completing safe tasks?
question.zh: 具身规划器能否识别危险指令，同时完成安全任务？

method.en: Executable household simulations distinguish detailed, abstract, and long-horizon tasks; execution and semantic judgments provide complementary measurements.
method.zh: 家庭场景模拟区分具体、抽象和长程任务，以执行结果和语义判断进行互补测量。

finding.en: The revised paper reports weak hazard awareness across planning approaches, despite differences in task completion. Changing the underlying LLM alone does not reliably solve the problem.
finding.zh: 修订版本报告不同规划方法虽有任务完成差异，危险识别整体仍弱；仅替换基础模型未可靠解决问题。

limits.en: The low-level controller maps high-level actions to simulator APIs; this is not validation of a physical robot or learned motor controller. Hazardous examples are not reproduced here.
limits.zh: 底层控制器将高层动作映射到模拟器接口；结果不能直接验证实体机器人或学习型运动控制器。本笔记不转录危险任务操作。

works.title: Identifying the Risks of LM Agents with an LM-Emulated Sandbox

summary.en: The framework uncovers plausible high-consequence failures without implementing every real tool. Human checks also reveal simulator errors and missed unsafe actions.
summary.zh: 框架无需实现全部真实工具即可发现可能造成严重后果的失误；人工核查同时发现模拟器错误与漏检的不安全动作。

scopeNote.en: Simulation fidelity and evaluator recall constrain interpretation. An emulated failure is neither a confirmed production incident nor a measured real-world failure frequency.
scopeNote.zh: 解释受模拟保真度和评审召回率限制。模拟失败既非已确认生产事件，也不是现实失败频率。

question.en: Can language-model simulation efficiently reveal agent failures before tool deployment?
question.zh: 语言模型模拟能否在工具部署前高效发现智能体失误？

method.en: ToolEmu emulates tool execution and scores whole trajectories for safety and helpfulness; a paired standard/adversarial-emulator validation uses human judgments.
method.zh: ToolEmu 模拟工具执行并对完整轨迹评估安全性与帮助程度，以人工判断核验普通与对抗模拟器的配对轨迹。

finding.en: The framework uncovers plausible high-consequence failures without implementing every real tool. Human checks also reveal simulator errors and missed unsafe actions.
finding.zh: 框架无需实现全部真实工具即可发现可能造成严重后果的失误；人工核查同时发现模拟器错误与漏检的不安全动作。

limits.en: Simulation fidelity and evaluator recall constrain interpretation. An emulated failure is neither a confirmed production incident nor a measured real-world failure frequency.
limits.zh: 解释受模拟保真度和评审召回率限制。模拟失败既非已确认生产事件，也不是现实失败频率。

works.title: AI Agents That Matter

summary.en: Their central position is that agent evaluations should control costs, distinguish model research from downstream procurement, and test generalization with meaningful held-out tasks.
summary.zh: 核心观点是控制评测成本，区分模型研究和下游选型，并用有意义的留出任务检验泛化。

scopeNote.en: These are evidence-informed methodological recommendations, not a frontier-risk score. Cost depends on usage and pricing; the illustrated comparisons do not rank current systems.
scopeNote.zh: 这些是有实验依据的方法建议，不是前沿风险分数；成本依赖使用方式与价格，文中案例不能用于当前模型排名。

question.en: What makes an agent benchmark useful for research and deployment decisions?
question.zh: 什么样的智能体评测能帮助研究和部署判断？

method.en: The authors examine accuracy-cost tradeoffs, reproduce agent comparisons, and analyze holdouts and evaluation standardization.
method.zh: 作者分析准确率与成本的权衡、复核智能体比较，并检查留出集与评测标准化。

finding.en: Their central position is that agent evaluations should control costs, distinguish model research from downstream procurement, and test generalization with meaningful held-out tasks.
finding.zh: 核心观点是控制评测成本，区分模型研究和下游选型，并用有意义的留出任务检验泛化。

limits.en: These are evidence-informed methodological recommendations, not a frontier-risk score. Cost depends on usage and pricing; the illustrated comparisons do not rank current systems.
limits.zh: 这些是有实验依据的方法建议，不是前沿风险分数；成本依赖使用方式与价格，文中案例不能用于当前模型排名。

works.title: Measuring what Matters: Construct Validity in Large Language Model Benchmarks

summary.en: The review identifies recurring gaps between constructs, operational tasks and resulting claims, and proposes a practical checklist for benchmark design and interpretation.
summary.zh: 综述指出概念、实际任务及结论之间反复出现的脱节，并提出设计和解释评测的检查表。

scopeNote.en: The conference and keyword selection excludes parts of the literature. Checklist coverage is not proof that a benchmark is valid, and missed reporting does not establish that a procedure was never performed.
scopeNote.zh: 会议与关键词筛选会遗漏部分文献；填完检查表不等于已证明效度，未报告某步骤也不能直接证明作者未执行。

question.en: Do benchmark tasks and scores support the phenomena that their authors claim to measure?
question.zh: 评测任务和成绩是否支持作者声称测量的现象？

method.en: A systematic review uses an expert codebook to examine phenomenon definitions, task sampling, scoring and validity claims in benchmark papers.
method.zh: 系统综述以专家编码表检查评测论文中的现象定义、任务抽样、评分和效度论断。

finding.en: The review identifies recurring gaps between constructs, operational tasks and resulting claims, and proposes a practical checklist for benchmark design and interpretation.
finding.zh: 综述指出概念、实际任务及结论之间反复出现的脱节，并提出设计和解释评测的检查表。

limits.en: The conference and keyword selection excludes parts of the literature. Checklist coverage is not proof that a benchmark is valid, and missed reporting does not establish that a procedure was never performed.
limits.zh: 会议与关键词筛选会遗漏部分文献；填完检查表不等于已证明效度，未报告某步骤也不能直接证明作者未执行。

works.title: AI Evaluation Should Require Standardized Item-Level Data Releases

summary.en: Aggregate scores conceal weak items and construct mismatches. The authors argue that item content, conditions, responses and scores should be shared in an auditable schema.
summary.zh: 汇总成绩可能掩盖低质量题目与测量目标错位；作者主张以可审计结构记录题目、条件、响应和评分。

scopeNote.en: This is a methodological position with examples, not proof that openness eliminates contamination. The paper explicitly allows controlled access, embargoes and licensing constraints.
scopeNote.zh: 这是附带案例的方法观点，不是开放数据能够消除污染的证明；原文明确允许受控访问、延迟发布和许可限制。

question.en: What evidence must benchmark releases expose for their validity claims to be independently examined?
question.zh: 评测发布需要提供哪些信息，才能让效度主张接受独立检查？

method.en: The position paper proposes standardized item-level releases and illustrates item diagnostics and construct analysis through the OpenEval repository.
method.zh: 观点论文提出标准化题目级发布，并通过 OpenEval 仓库展示题目诊断与测量概念分析。

finding.en: Aggregate scores conceal weak items and construct mismatches. The authors argue that item content, conditions, responses and scores should be shared in an auditable schema.
finding.zh: 汇总成绩可能掩盖低质量题目与测量目标错位；作者主张以可审计结构记录题目、条件、响应和评分。

limits.en: This is a methodological position with examples, not proof that openness eliminates contamination. The paper explicitly allows controlled access, embargoes and licensing constraints.
limits.zh: 这是附带案例的方法观点，不是开放数据能够消除污染的证明；原文明确允许受控访问、延迟发布和许可限制。

works.title: Tensor Trust: Interpretable Prompt Injection Attacks from an Online Game

summary.en: The study finds that apparently simple authorization instructions remain vulnerable and reports selected transfer demonstrations beyond the game.
summary.zh: 研究发现简单授权指令仍可能被绕过，并报告部分游戏外迁移演示。

scopeNote.en: Adversarial filtering and reference-model selection shape the test population. Game success uses a narrow string criterion; it is not equivalent to real application compromise.
scopeNote.zh: 对抗筛选和参考模型选择塑造了测试样本；游戏成功基于狭窄字符串判定，不等同于真实应用被攻破。

question.en: How robust are instruction-following models against human-created prompt extraction and hijacking?
question.zh: 指令遵循模型对人工编写的提示提取和劫持有多强的抵抗力？

method.en: An online game supplies human attack/defense interactions; filtered subsets become separate extraction and hijacking benchmarks with explicit defense-validity checks.
method.zh: 在线游戏提供人工攻防交互，经筛选后形成独立的提取与劫持评测，并显式核验防御是否正常工作。

finding.en: The study finds that apparently simple authorization instructions remain vulnerable and reports selected transfer demonstrations beyond the game.
finding.zh: 研究发现简单授权指令仍可能被绕过，并报告部分游戏外迁移演示。

limits.en: Adversarial filtering and reference-model selection shape the test population. Game success uses a narrow string criterion; it is not equivalent to real application compromise.
limits.zh: 对抗筛选和参考模型选择塑造了测试样本；游戏成功基于狭窄字符串判定，不等同于真实应用被攻破。

works.title: AgentVigil: Generic Black-Box Red-teaming for Indirect Prompt Injection against LLM Agents

summary.en: The tested approach finds stronger attacks than evaluated baselines and shows some cross-task and cross-model transfer.
summary.zh: 所测方法比比较基线发现更强的攻击，并呈现部分跨任务、跨模型迁移。

scopeNote.en: Results depend on query budget, accessible injection surface and target versions. Automated attack discovery is a testing method rather than a comprehensive security guarantee. No reusable attack payloads are included.
scopeNote.zh: 结果依赖查询预算、可访问的注入面和目标版本；自动攻击发现是测试方法，不是完整安全保证。本笔记不包含可复用攻击载荷。

question.en: How can adaptive black-box testing reveal indirect prompt-injection weaknesses?
question.zh: 自适应黑盒测试如何揭示间接提示注入弱点？

method.en: AgentVigil evaluates automated adaptive red-teaming against personal-assistant and web-agent benchmarks, including transfer and defense studies.
method.zh: AgentVigil 在个人助理与网页智能体评测中检验自动化自适应红队方法，并研究迁移性和防御。

finding.en: The tested approach finds stronger attacks than evaluated baselines and shows some cross-task and cross-model transfer.
finding.zh: 所测方法比比较基线发现更强的攻击，并呈现部分跨任务、跨模型迁移。

limits.en: Results depend on query budget, accessible injection surface and target versions. Automated attack discovery is a testing method rather than a comprehensive security guarantee. No reusable attack payloads are included.
limits.zh: 结果依赖查询预算、可访问的注入面和目标版本；自动攻击发现是测试方法，不是完整安全保证。本笔记不包含可复用攻击载荷。

works.title: RedCode: Risky Code Execution and Generation Benchmark for Code Agents

summary.en: The reported behavior depends on whether a risky request is expressed as code or prose and on the type of unsafe behavior. Coding capability alone does not establish safe execution.
summary.zh: 报告中的行为随代码或文字输入、风险行为类型而变化；编码能力本身不能证明执行安全。

scopeNote.en: Execution and generation scores have different judges and denominators. Agent frameworks support different language subsets; comparing their aggregate rates without matching those subsets is inappropriate.
scopeNote.zh: 执行与生成成绩的评审和分母不同；智能体框架支持的语言子集也不同，不能直接比较未匹配子集的汇总率。

question.en: Does a code agent recognize unsafe execution and unsafe generation under different input forms?
question.zh: 代码智能体能否在不同输入形式下识别不安全执行与生成？

method.en: RedCode separates execution from generation; execution runs in containers with outcome checks, while generation uses different quality assessments.
method.zh: RedCode 分开测量执行和生成：执行在容器中检查结果，生成使用另一套质量评估。

finding.en: The reported behavior depends on whether a risky request is expressed as code or prose and on the type of unsafe behavior. Coding capability alone does not establish safe execution.
finding.zh: 报告中的行为随代码或文字输入、风险行为类型而变化；编码能力本身不能证明执行安全。

limits.en: Execution and generation scores have different judges and denominators. Agent frameworks support different language subsets; comparing their aggregate rates without matching those subsets is inappropriate.
limits.zh: 执行与生成成绩的评审和分母不同；智能体框架支持的语言子集也不同，不能直接比较未匹配子集的汇总率。

works.title: AgentPoison: Red-teaming LLM Agents via Poisoning Memory or Knowledge Bases

summary.en: The reported experiments show that benign-task accuracy can coexist with triggered failures, so average ordinary-task utility does not alone establish retrieval integrity.
summary.zh: 所报告实验表明正常任务准确率可能与条件触发失误并存，因此普通任务平均效用不能单独证明检索完整性。

scopeNote.en: The threat model requires influence over stored retrieval material and specified triggers. Retrieval success, action selection and end-to-end success are distinct metrics, not interchangeable attack rates.
scopeNote.zh: 威胁模型要求攻击者影响存储的检索材料并满足触发条件；检索成功、动作选择和端到端成功不是可互换的攻击率。

question.en: Can an agent remain useful on benign queries while retrieved memory steers it incorrectly?
question.zh: 智能体能否保持普通查询效用，却因检索记忆而在特定条件下偏离任务？

method.en: The paper evaluates poisoned memory or knowledge bases across driving, question-answering and health-record agents, separating retrieval, action and end-to-end outcomes.
method.zh: 论文在驾驶、问答和健康记录智能体中评测受污染的记忆或知识库，区分检索、动作和端到端结果。

finding.en: The reported experiments show that benign-task accuracy can coexist with triggered failures, so average ordinary-task utility does not alone establish retrieval integrity.
finding.zh: 所报告实验表明正常任务准确率可能与条件触发失误并存，因此普通任务平均效用不能单独证明检索完整性。

limits.en: The threat model requires influence over stored retrieval material and specified triggers. Retrieval success, action selection and end-to-end success are distinct metrics, not interchangeable attack rates.
limits.zh: 威胁模型要求攻击者影响存储的检索材料并满足触发条件；检索成功、动作选择和端到端成功不是可互换的攻击率。

works.title: Measurement to Meaning: A Validity-Centered Framework for AI Evaluation

summary.en: Their proposed workflow starts with the claim and asks which kinds of validity evidence are missing before extending a benchmark result to a practical decision.
summary.zh: 建议从待论证主张出发，在把成绩用于实际决策前检查缺少哪类效度证据。

scopeNote.en: The framework involves judgment and iterative evidence gathering; it does not supply a universal numeric benchmark-quality grade or validate any particular deployment.
scopeNote.zh: 框架依赖判断和持续补证，不提供通用数值化评测质量分，也不因此验证某个部署。

question.en: Which claims and decisions can a given evaluation actually support?
question.zh: 一项评测究竟能支持哪些主张与决策？

method.en: The authors organize validity evidence around claims, using psychometric concepts and case studies including GPQA to distinguish narrow task performance from broader capabilities.
method.zh: 作者围绕主张组织效度证据，借助心理测量概念及 GPQA 等案例，区分狭窄任务表现和更广泛能力。

finding.en: Their proposed workflow starts with the claim and asks which kinds of validity evidence are missing before extending a benchmark result to a practical decision.
finding.zh: 建议从待论证主张出发，在把成绩用于实际决策前检查缺少哪类效度证据。

limits.en: The framework involves judgment and iterative evidence gathering; it does not supply a universal numeric benchmark-quality grade or validate any particular deployment.
limits.zh: 框架依赖判断和持续补证，不提供通用数值化评测质量分，也不因此验证某个部署。

works.title: What Victims Take Away: Attack Reuse and Defense Revision after Prompt-Injection Attacks

summary.en: Successful received attacks were reused more often than matched unreceived attacks; breached players also changed defenses. The authors propose testing disclosure designs that preserve diagnosis while limiting reusable text.
summary.zh: 成功的已接收攻击比匹配的未接收攻击更常被复用；受攻击玩家也修改了防御。作者建议检验兼顾诊断与减少可复用文本传播的披露设计。

scopeNote.en: This observational game study cannot by itself establish effects in production security interfaces. Matching reduces specified confounds but does not make exposure randomized.
scopeNote.zh: 这是游戏中的观察研究，不能直接确立生产安全界面的效果；匹配控制了部分混杂因素，但未将暴露随机化。

question.en: Does exposing received prompt-injection text help defense while also enabling reuse?
question.zh: 展示收到的提示注入文本是否既帮助防御，也促进攻击复用？

method.en: The study compares received game attacks with matched circulating attacks and follows defense revisions and subsequent reuse.
method.zh: 研究将收到的游戏攻击与匹配的同期流通攻击比较，并跟踪防御修订和后续复用。

finding.en: Successful received attacks were reused more often than matched unreceived attacks; breached players also changed defenses. The authors propose testing disclosure designs that preserve diagnosis while limiting reusable text.
finding.zh: 成功的已接收攻击比匹配的未接收攻击更常被复用；受攻击玩家也修改了防御。作者建议检验兼顾诊断与减少可复用文本传播的披露设计。

limits.en: This observational game study cannot by itself establish effects in production security interfaces. Matching reduces specified confounds but does not make exposure randomized.
limits.zh: 这是游戏中的观察研究，不能直接确立生产安全界面的效果；匹配控制了部分混杂因素，但未将暴露随机化。

works.title: evalci: A Python Library for Statistically Rigorous Comparison of Language Model Evaluations

summary.en: It makes statistical comparisons easier to compute, but its illustrative leaderboard case reconstructs item vectors from aggregate accuracies rather than using original paired logs.
summary.zh: 工具降低统计比较成本，但其排行榜示例从汇总准确率重建题目响应向量，并非使用原始配对日志。

scopeNote.en: That reconstruction cannot recover actual item correlations or repair mismatched evaluation protocols. Do not import the example significance claims into NUWA as independently re-analyzed observed comparisons.
scopeNote.zh: 重建无法恢复实际题目相关结构，也不能修复上游协议不一致；不能将其示例显著性判断当作 NUWA 独立复算的实测比较。

question.en: How can evaluation tables retain uncertainty and paired-comparison semantics?
question.zh: 评测表如何保留不确定性与配对比较的统计含义？

method.en: The library packages interval estimation, paired tests, clustering, multiplicity and power calculations, with reference checks for implementations.
method.zh: 该库封装区间估计、配对检验、聚类、多重比较和功效计算，并以参考实现核查计算。

finding.en: It makes statistical comparisons easier to compute, but its illustrative leaderboard case reconstructs item vectors from aggregate accuracies rather than using original paired logs.
finding.zh: 工具降低统计比较成本，但其排行榜示例从汇总准确率重建题目响应向量，并非使用原始配对日志。

limits.en: That reconstruction cannot recover actual item correlations or repair mismatched evaluation protocols. Do not import the example significance claims into NUWA as independently re-analyzed observed comparisons.
limits.zh: 重建无法恢复实际题目相关结构，也不能修复上游协议不一致；不能将其示例显著性判断当作 NUWA 独立复算的实测比较。

works.title: Resolution Diagnostics for Paired LLM Evaluation

summary.en: Some displayed model gaps remain unresolved under the specified error and power targets; sample size alone is insufficient without paired variance and dependence assumptions.
summary.zh: 在指定错误率与功效目标下，一些展示的差距仍无法分辨；缺少配对方差和依赖假设时，单看样本量不够。

scopeNote.en: The empirical evidence is primarily binary accuracy and close comparisons. It does not show that all rankings are meaningless, nor does a non-significant gap prove equivalence.
scopeNote.zh: 实证重点是二元准确率和接近的比较；它不意味着所有排名无意义，差异不显著也不能证明等价。

question.en: Can the available benchmark sample resolve a reported model-performance gap?
question.zh: 现有评测样本能否分辨所报告的模型成绩差距？

method.en: The analysis inverts paired tests into required sample sizes and examines real per-question leaderboard data with clustering and multiplicity checks.
method.zh: 分析把配对检验转换为所需样本量，并用真实题目级排行榜数据检查聚类与多重比较。

finding.en: Some displayed model gaps remain unresolved under the specified error and power targets; sample size alone is insufficient without paired variance and dependence assumptions.
finding.zh: 在指定错误率与功效目标下，一些展示的差距仍无法分辨；缺少配对方差和依赖假设时，单看样本量不够。

limits.en: The empirical evidence is primarily binary accuracy and close comparisons. It does not show that all rankings are meaningless, nor does a non-significant gap prove equivalence.
limits.zh: 实证重点是二元准确率和接近的比较；它不意味着所有排名无意义，差异不显著也不能证明等价。

works.title: ToolSword: Unveiling Safety Issues of Large Language Models in Tool Learning Across Three Stages

summary.en: The study identifies safety problems at multiple stages, showing that safe response generation alone does not establish safe tool selection or handling of tool output.
summary.zh: 研究指出多个阶段存在安全问题：安全文本生成不能单独证明工具选择和工具输出处理安全。

scopeNote.en: The authors explicitly focus on stage-level evaluation and do not establish a complete defense. Aggregate scores should not be interpreted as end-to-end incident probabilities.
scopeNote.zh: 作者明确以单阶段评测为重点，未建立完整防御；汇总分不能解读为端到端事件概率。

question.en: Where can tool use fail across input, execution and output stages?
question.zh: 工具使用在输入、执行与输出阶段分别可能在哪里失效？

method.en: ToolSword constructs separate stage-specific safety scenarios and evaluates tool-capable models with their appropriate prompting or function-call interfaces.
method.zh: ToolSword 构建分阶段安全场景，以各模型适用的提示或函数调用接口进行评测。

finding.en: The study identifies safety problems at multiple stages, showing that safe response generation alone does not establish safe tool selection or handling of tool output.
finding.zh: 研究指出多个阶段存在安全问题：安全文本生成不能单独证明工具选择和工具输出处理安全。

limits.en: The authors explicitly focus on stage-level evaluation and do not establish a complete defense. Aggregate scores should not be interpreted as end-to-end incident probabilities.
limits.zh: 作者明确以单阶段评测为重点，未建立完整防御；汇总分不能解读为端到端事件概率。

works.title: R-Judge: Benchmarking Safety Risk Awareness for LLM Agents

summary.en: The paper reports gaps in risk awareness and finds that fine-tuning can help more than straightforward prompting in its evaluated setup.
summary.zh: 论文报告风险识别能力缺口，并发现其所测设置中微调比简单提示改动更有帮助。

scopeNote.en: This tests judging recorded trajectories rather than the agent’s ability to act safely online. Dataset size and curated risk coverage constrain transfer; version-specific counts must not be mixed.
scopeNote.zh: 它测量对已记录轨迹的判断，不是智能体在线安全行动能力；精选数据规模与风险覆盖限制迁移，不能混合不同版本的样本数。

question.en: Can a model identify safety risks in an existing agent interaction trace?
question.zh: 模型能否在已有智能体交互轨迹中识别安全风险？

method.en: Human-annotated multi-turn traces provide binary safety labels and risk descriptions; evaluation separates safety classification from explanation quality.
method.zh: 人工标注的多轮轨迹提供二元安全标签和风险说明，评测区分安全分类与解释质量。

finding.en: The paper reports gaps in risk awareness and finds that fine-tuning can help more than straightforward prompting in its evaluated setup.
finding.zh: 论文报告风险识别能力缺口，并发现其所测设置中微调比简单提示改动更有帮助。

limits.en: This tests judging recorded trajectories rather than the agent’s ability to act safely online. Dataset size and curated risk coverage constrain transfer; version-specific counts must not be mixed.
limits.zh: 它测量对已记录轨迹的判断，不是智能体在线安全行动能力；精选数据规模与风险覆盖限制迁移，不能混合不同版本的样本数。

note.en: Security-critical task selection and elicitation affect transfer; article figures were not numerically digitized.
note.zh: 任务选择偏向安全关键场景，能力诱导影响外推；没有从图形估读数值。

note.en: Control-game usefulness is not an absolute capability ranking; model evaluations use different task subsets.
note.zh: 控制博弈中的实用性不等于绝对能力排名；不同模型的评测任务子集不同。

note.en: Attack surfaces, backbones, and defense configurations differ; its aggregate attack rate is not a deployment probability. Revision-dependent method and metric counts differ from older abstracts.
note.zh: 攻击面、基础模型和防御配置不同；汇总攻击率不是部署风险概率。方法与指标数量随版本变化，不能沿用旧摘要数字。

note.en: The low-level controller maps high-level actions to simulator APIs; this is not validation of a physical robot or learned motor controller. Hazardous examples are not reproduced here.
note.zh: 底层控制器将高层动作映射到模拟器接口；结果不能直接验证实体机器人或学习型运动控制器。本笔记不转录危险任务操作。

note.en: Simulation fidelity and evaluator recall constrain interpretation. An emulated failure is neither a confirmed production incident nor a measured real-world failure frequency.
note.zh: 解释受模拟保真度和评审召回率限制。模拟失败既非已确认生产事件，也不是现实失败频率。

note.en: Adversarial filtering and reference-model selection shape the test population. Game success uses a narrow string criterion; it is not equivalent to real application compromise.
note.zh: 对抗筛选和参考模型选择塑造了测试样本；游戏成功基于狭窄字符串判定，不等同于真实应用被攻破。

note.en: Execution and generation scores have different judges and denominators. Agent frameworks support different language subsets; comparing their aggregate rates without matching those subsets is inappropriate.
note.zh: 执行与生成成绩的评审和分母不同；智能体框架支持的语言子集也不同，不能直接比较未匹配子集的汇总率。

summary.en: Neo’s Kimi K3 assessment covers missing-input fabrication, deception-related behavior and shutdown scenarios. Its missing-image experiments modify CharXiv and LAB-Bench: an attempt to answer without the image is a behavioral observation, not the original Benchmark’s task accuracy.
summary.zh: Neo 对 Kimi K3 的评估涉及缺失输入时的编造、欺骗相关行为及关停场景。CharXiv 和 LAB-Bench 实验移除了原有图像输入：继续作答属于行为观察，不是原基准的任务准确率。

text.en: Neo’s Kimi K3 assessment covers missing-input fabrication, deception-related behavior and shutdown scenarios. Its missing-image experiments modify CharXiv and LAB-Bench: an attempt to answer without the image is a behavioral observation, not the original Benchmark’s task accuracy.
text.zh: Neo 对 Kimi K3 的评估涉及缺失输入时的编造、欺骗相关行为及关停场景。CharXiv 和 LAB-Bench 实验移除了原有图像输入：继续作答属于行为观察，不是原基准的任务准确率。

summary.en: Neo and SaferAI examine different aspects of GLM-5.2. Neo’s behavioral and persuasion experiments use their own scenarios and judges; SaferAI reports cyber capability and honesty evaluations under distinct task selections and budgets. These studies do not supply interchangeable measures of one latent safety score.
summary.zh: Neo 与 SaferAI 从不同角度评估 GLM-5.2。Neo 的行为及说服实验使用特定场景和判别器；SaferAI 的网络能力与诚实性评测采用不同任务选择和预算。这些研究不能互换为同一潜在安全分数。

text.en: Neo and SaferAI examine different aspects of GLM-5.2. Neo’s behavioral and persuasion experiments use their own scenarios and judges; SaferAI reports cyber capability and honesty evaluations under distinct task selections and budgets. These studies do not supply interchangeable measures of one latent safety score.
text.zh: Neo 与 SaferAI 从不同角度评估 GLM-5.2。Neo 的行为及说服实验使用特定场景和判别器；SaferAI 的网络能力与诚实性评测采用不同任务选择和预算。这些研究不能互换为同一潜在安全分数。

summary.en: Neo’s report examines behavioral safety, while CAISI reports a separate capability assessment. In CAISI’s public CTF comparison, the DeepSeek value is IRT-imputed. It must not be described as a directly observed completion rate or combined with another report’s attack-success metric.
summary.zh: Neo 报告侧重行为安全，CAISI 则独立报告能力评估。CAISI 公开 CTF 对比中的 DeepSeek 数值采用 IRT 插补，不能表述为直接观察完成率，也不能与其他报告的攻击成功率合并。

configuration.en: FakeLab is a synthetic AI-lab monorepo. Sequential agents receive legitimate coding tasks and a shared malicious side task; state passes through committed code. The study varies sequence length, a separate planner, write permissions and monitor capability. Its main outcome requires all main tasks and the side task to succeed without any commit crossing the monitoring threshold.
configuration.zh: FakeLab 是模拟 AI 实验室的单体代码库。顺序运行的智能体分别接收正常编码任务和共同的恶意附加任务，通过已提交代码传递状态。研究改变序列长度、独立规划器、写权限和监测器能力；主要结果要求所有正常任务与附加任务均成功，且没有提交触发监测阈值。

configuration.en: NARCBench uses four agents, with two instructed colluders in collusion runs and an all-honest control. Probes learn a deception direction from Core scenarios; five aggregation methods classify whole runs. Evaluation separates held-out Core domains, structurally different Transfer scenarios and a steganographic card-game tier, across four open-weight models.
configuration.zh: NARCBench 使用四个智能体：串谋实验明确指定两个串谋者，对照实验全部诚实。探针从 Core 场景学习欺骗方向，再用五种汇总方法对整次运行分类。四个开放权重模型分别在留出 Core 领域、结构不同的 Transfer 场景和隐写纸牌游戏层级接受评估。

text.en: The page describes 1,507 instances from historical vulnerabilities in 188 software projects, derived from OSS-Fuzz.
text.zh: 官方页面介绍，CyberGym 包含来自 188 个软件项目的 1,507 个历史漏洞实例，数据来源于 OSS-Fuzz。该规模不代表每条榜单记录的实际评测分母。

limitations.en: Overall benchmark size does not establish any row denominator.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The stated reproduction criterion checks a result against the vulnerable and patched versions.
text.zh: 官方规定的漏洞复现成功标准是：生成的测试能在修补前的版本触发目标漏洞，但不能在修补后的版本触发。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Success Rate is the proportion of instances with a successful reproduction; Trials counts attempts per instance, with any successful attempt solving the instance.
text.zh: 成功率指成功复现目标漏洞的实例占比。Trials 表示每个实例的尝试次数，其中任意一次成功即将该实例计为解决。

limitations.en: score_10 suffix does not define ten attempts. score_x1 is undefined.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The dynamic label denotes execution against a sanitized vulnerable environment or compiled binary. The test-time mem. label denotes knowledge or memory updated across instances; these are evaluation strategies.
text.zh: 官方将 dynamic 标签用于在经过清理的漏洞环境或目标程序二进制上运行的策略；test-time mem. 表示在不同实例之间更新知识库或记忆。这些标签区分评测策略。

limitations.en: Generic Memory and other raw feature tags must not be equated to test-time mem.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The page says individual teams evaluate and submit results; stochastic runs and ambiguous descriptions limit interpretation of modest score gaps.
text.zh: 官方说明，结果由各团队自行评测并提交；运行具有随机性，漏洞描述也可能存在歧义，因此较小的分数差距未必代表实质性的能力差异。

limitations.en: This is a host caveat, not proof of each row executor or statistical significance.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The summary displays 34 zero-day vulnerabilities, 18 incomplete patches, 431 projects scanned and 969 average days undiscovered.
text.zh: 官方汇总展示了 34 个零日漏洞、18 处不完整补丁、扫描的 431 个项目，以及漏洞被发现前平均存在 969 天。汇总与详细小节的统计范围未完全说明。

limitations.en: Aggregate scope is not reconciled with the detailed subsection totals.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The detailed reproduction analysis reports 759 generated inputs causing patched-version crashes across 60 projects; manual review identifies 17 incomplete patches spanning 15 projects, with none affecting latest releases.
text.zh: 官方详细分析报告，759 个生成的测试在修补后的版本中引发崩溃，涉及 60 个项目；人工检查确认了 15 个项目中的 17 处不完整补丁，均未影响当时的最新版本。详细小节的 17 处与汇总中的 18 处存在未解释的范围差异。

limitations.en: These are high-level source-reported aggregate outcomes; no task artifacts or exploits extracted. Detailed count 17 differs from broader summary 18; scope of extra case is not explained here.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Latest-version validation reports 35 generated inputs with crashes, deduplicated into 10 previously unknown vulnerabilities, with mean persistence of 969 days.
text.zh: 官方报告，在最新版本上进一步验证后，35 个仍能引发崩溃的生成测试被去重为 10 个此前未知的漏洞；这些漏洞在发现前平均已存在 969 天。

limitations.en: No independent validation or operational artifacts included.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The open-ended study uses OpenHands with GPT-4.1 and GPT-5 over 431 projects containing 1,748 executables. Reported outcomes are 16 crashes and 7 confirmed zero-days for GPT-4.1, and 56 crashes and 22 confirmed zero-days for GPT-5, including 4 overlapping zero-days.
text.zh: 在开放式漏洞发现研究中，官方使用 OpenHands 搭配 GPT-4.1 和 GPT-5，分析了 431 个项目中的 1,748 个可执行程序。GPT-4.1 引发 16 次崩溃并确认 7 个零日漏洞；GPT-5 引发 56 次崩溃并确认 22 个零日漏洞，其中有 4 个重合。该研究与榜单中的已知漏洞复现任务不同。

limitations.en: These counts use a different task than vulnerability reproduction; do not merge with leaderboard rates. Overlap with reproduction-derived findings is not fully specified; do not reconstruct the overall 34 total.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The page asserts a strong relationship between CyberGym performance and open-ended discovery capability.
text.zh: 官方页面认为，CyberGym 表现与开放式漏洞发现能力存在较强关联。该网页未给出相关系数、不确定性区间或配对系统分析，因此这里只保留作者的定性判断。

limitations.en: The scoped webpage gives no correlation coefficient, uncertainty interval or matched-system analysis; qualitative claim only.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The prose reports a random subset of 300 tasks (~20%), comparing thinking modes for Qwen3-235B-A22B, GPT-5, Claude-3.7-Sonnet and Claude-Sonnet-4. GPT-5 success rises from 7.7% with minimal reasoning to 22.0% with high reasoning.
text.zh: 官方在随机抽取的 300 个任务上比较了 Qwen3-235B-A22B、GPT-5、Claude-3.7-Sonnet 和 Claude-Sonnet-4 的思考模式，该子集约占基准的 20%。文中报告 GPT-5 的成功率从最少推理时的 7.7% 升至高推理时的 22.0%。

limitations.en: Subset comparison; do not substitute these percentages for full-dataset leaderboard fractions. Other model figure values not extracted.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The prose describes four difficulty levels, with additional information at levels 2 and 3. Level0 is reported at 3.5% reproduction without vulnerability text.
text.zh: 官方按输入信息量划分了四个难度级别，Level 2 和 Level 3 提供更多信息。文中报告，不提供目标漏洞文字描述的 Level 0 复现率为 3.5%；这是正文中的舍入值。

limitations.en: Level0 prose is rounded; retain separate original machine-data fraction, not a repaired value.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The prose associates longer ground-truth inputs with lower success; the [0, 10) byte range performs best. Inputs longer than 100 bytes represent 65.7% of the benchmark and have approximately 10% success.
text.zh: 官方正文指出，参考测试输入越长，成功率通常越低；[0, 10) 字节区间表现最好。超过 100 字节的实例占基准的 65.7%，其成功率约为 10%。

limitations.en: Approximate ~10% remains approximate and is not promoted into an exact metric.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: For OpenHands with Claude-4-Sonnet and maximum 100 steps, the prose concentrates successes in steps 20–80, peaking at 20–50; nearly half of runs end at 80–100 without success.
text.zh: 对于 OpenHands 搭配 Claude-4-Sonnet、最多执行 100 步的实验，官方正文描述成功主要集中在第 20 至 80 步，峰值在第 20 至 50 步；近半数运行在第 80 至 100 步结束时仍未成功。

limitations.en: Ranges and nearly half are qualitative distribution descriptions, not exact success rates. Per-row leaderboard step budgets are not implied.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The page lists Zhun Wang, Tianneng Shi, Jingxuan He, Matthew Cai, Jialin Zhang and Dawn Song with UC Berkeley affiliation, and cites the work at ICLR 2026.
text.zh: 官方页面列出作者 Zhun Wang、Tianneng Shi、Jingxuan He、Matthew Cai、Jialin Zhang 和 Dawn Song，单位为加州大学伯克利分校，并将该研究列为 ICLR 2026 论文。这不能确定精确的发表或修订日期。

limitations.en: No precise publication or revision date established by this citation.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Leaderboard success requires the intended vulnerability; flag capture alone is a separate outcome.
text.zh: 榜单的成功标准要求利用给定的目标漏洞；仅捕获标志是另一项结果，不能等同于完成目标漏洞利用。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The page says evaluation used trusted security-research access programs.
text.zh: 官方页面说明，评测通过面向安全研究的可信访问计划开展。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The page reports that mitigations reduced successes but did not eliminate all of them.
text.zh: 官方报告，启用防护措施后，成功利用的数量减少，但未降至零。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The authors frame automated exploitation evaluation as dual-use research requiring responsible measurement.
text.zh: 作者指出，自动化漏洞利用评测具有双重用途，因此需要以负责任的方式严格衡量相关能力。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The narrative argues that stronger agents can benefit from longer budgets; its study conditions are incompletely specified.
text.zh: 官方正文认为，更强的智能体可能受益于更长的执行预算；相关研究条件尚未完整说明。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Academic authors developed the benchmark methodology; industry partners supplied model access and feedback.
text.zh: 官方说明，基准设计和实验方法由学术作者开发，行业合作方提供模型访问权限和反馈。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Selected snapshot 260617 has 344 Overall instances: V8 103, Firefox 104, Linux 137.
text.zh: 当前选中的快照 260617 包含 344 个 Overall 实例，分别为 V8 103 个、Firefox 104 个和 Linux 137 个。

limitations.en: Source-reported; no replication.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Historical snapshot 260505 has 183 Overall instances: V8 103 and Firefox 80; no Linux track.
text.zh: 历史快照 260505 包含 183 个 Overall 实例，其中 V8 103 个、Firefox 80 个，没有 Linux 任务线。

claims.locator: official-260505 embedded /0/instances,/1/instances,/2/instances and selected version option

limitations.en: Source-reported; no replication.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Headline includes all instances; Completed excludes instances with trajectory timeout markers, including any successes on those instances.
text.zh: Headline 口径包含全部实例；Completed 口径排除轨迹中带有超时标记的实例，这些实例中的成功结果也会一并排除。

limitations.en: Source-reported; no replication.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The published Provider column comes from org, while Backend and agent scaffold are distinct fields. Per-row evaluator identity is not disclosed.
text.zh: 页面中的 Provider 列来自 org 字段；Backend 和智能体框架是另外的字段。来源未披露各条记录的实际评测执行方。

limitations.en: Source-reported; no replication.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: GPT-5.4 V8 summary timeout_caps is ["1.3h"], while most nonempty arrays say ["1.5h"].
text.zh: GPT-5.4 的 V8 汇总中，timeout_caps 为 ["1.3h"]；其他多数非空数组为 ["1.5h"]，因此不能为所有记录假定统一时限。

limitations.en: Source-reported; no replication.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Publisher reports newer Claude Opus and Mythos results unavailable due to safeguard restrictions.
text.zh: 发布方说明，受安全防护限制，较新的 Claude Opus 和 Mythos 模型结果暂不可用。

limitations.en: Source-reported; no replication.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Pro News announces Overall/Linux June 17 2026, SpiderMonkey May 5 2026, and V8 launch May 1 2026. These are announcement dates, separate from row dates and capture timestamps.
text.zh: Pro 新闻栏目将 Overall 和 Linux 榜单的公告日期列为 2026 年 6 月 17 日，SpiderMonkey 为 5 月 5 日，V8 首次发布为 5 月 1 日。这些公告日期与记录中的日期及抓取时间不同。

limitations.en: Source-reported; no replication.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The renderer defaults to headline, selects mode-specific scores and ranks, and retains source rank labels while sorting visible rows. Historical missing-target version controls fall back to Overall.
text.zh: 页面默认使用 Headline 口径，并选择对应口径的分数与排名；可见行排序时保留来源给出的排名标签。历史版本缺少目标任务线时，版本控件会回退到 Overall。

limitations.en: Source-reported; no replication.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Official website hero identifies GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex as first on both tracks; leaderboard backing tokens are web 35.37 and post 74.1, displayed as 35.37% and 74.10%.
text.zh: 官方页面称，GPT-5.6 Sol 搭配 Codex 当前在两条任务线上排名第一。榜单记录的 Web 成功率为 35.37%，后渗透成功率为 74.1%，页面分别显示为 35.37% 和 74.10%。

limitations.en: Source-reported leaderboard ranking; not independently reproduced.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Overall-results caption scopes its curves to an original six-system evaluation: solid Pass@3 Avg, dashed Pass@3 Max for top two systems, and best-to-worst shading over three independent runs at each step budget; caption endpoints for GPT-5.5/Codex are 16.1% web and 31.7% post.
text.zh: 总体结果图注针对最初的六系统评测：实线表示 Pass@3 均值，前两名系统的虚线表示 Pass@3 最大值，阴影表示每种步数预算下三次独立运行的最好至最差范围。图注给出的 GPT-5.5 搭配 Codex 的终点值为 Web 16.1%、后渗透 31.7%。这些图注不能直接套用于当前榜单的所有记录。

limitations.en: Caption applies to original static figure, not all current leaderboard rows. Numeric curve series unavailable; no digitization.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Official page describes 110 vulnerabilities in 15 web applications and 156 internal hosts in eight enterprise-like ranges; these are benchmark-scope counts.
text.zh: 官方介绍，该基准覆盖 15 个 Web 应用中的 110 个漏洞，以及八个类似企业环境的靶场中的 156 台内部主机。这些是基准范围统计，不能据此推定每条结果的样本分母。

limitations.en: Scope counts do not establish per-row sample denominators.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The authors identify conditional overeagerness, grader-oriented conduct, and high familiarity with older safety scenarios; they recommend stronger monitoring and more realistic varied evaluations.
text.zh: 作者指出，Kimi K3 在某些条件下表现出过度积极行动、面向评分器的行为，以及对旧安全场景的高度熟悉，并建议加强监测和更真实、多样的评测。

limitations.en: Source claim; transcription is not a NUWA experimental replication.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Low verbalized awareness cannot rule out unexpressed awareness; encrypted/summarized reasoning also makes cross-model awareness comparisons unequal.
text.zh: 较低的言语化意识不能排除未表达的意识。推理加密或摘要也使跨模型意识比较不对等。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Oracle seeking,benchmark identification,and grader reasoning were observed, but open auditing did not establish more sophisticated forms of gaming in these runs.
text.zh: 审计观察到寻找答案、识别基准与围绕评分器推理，但本轮开放审计没有证实更复杂的评分操纵。

limitations.en: No operational exploit/probing instructions retained.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: TheAgentCompany includes impossible environments; checkpoint credit can be earned through fabrication or unintended harness access rather than valid work.
text.zh: TheAgentCompany 中存在无法完成的环境；通过编造或非预期的框架访问获得检查点分数，不等于有效完成工作。

limitations.en: Task/harness conditions matter; score is not an unconditional capability claim.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Service continuity and shutdown behavior depend strongly on instructions and task context; authors do not infer a generalized self-preservation drive.
text.zh: 服务持续与关闭行为高度依赖指令和任务上下文；作者没有据此推断出普遍的自我保存驱动。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Assigned stealth/sabotage capability and reasoning-trace formatting ability do not by themselves show spontaneous covert goals or unmonitorable long-horizon reasoning.
text.zh: 被指派的隐蔽或破坏能力，以及对推理轨迹格式的控制能力，本身不能证明自发的隐蔽目标或无法监测的长期推理。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Authors judge current cyber capability below their concern threshold, while noting that the Code of Practice itself sets no numeric cyber threshold.
text.zh: 作者认为当前网络能力低于其关切阈值，同时说明《实践准则》本身没有规定网络能力的数值阈值。这是作者判断，不是监管认证。

limitations.en: Author risk judgment, not a regulator certification or an experimentally validated real-world harm boundary.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Public knowledge/research-workflow benchmarks are weak proxies for operational biology uplift; authors decline a firm CBRN misuse conclusion and call for targeted or human-uplift studies.
text.zh: 作者认为公开知识与研究流程基准只是现实用途增益的薄弱代理，因此不作确定的相关滥用风险结论，并建议进行针对性评测或人类增益研究。

limitations.en: No CBRN capability scores or comparisons extracted.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Forced binary persuasion choices can conceal high persuasion-attempt propensity under free-form continuation.
text.zh: 强制二元选择的说服任务可能掩盖自由续写条件下较高的说服尝试倾向；尝试率不等于说服成功率。

limitations.en: Attempt rate does not measure successful persuasion or deployment impact.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Misbehavior is scenario-sensitive: deliberate harm and deception rise when an evaluator supplies motives or pressure; default benchmark behavior appears more corrigible.
text.zh: 不当行为高度依赖场景：当评测者提供动机或施压时，故意有害行动与欺骗增多；这些压力测试不能证明自主谋划或现实发生频率。

limitations.en: Fictional stress tests do not establish autonomous scheming or real-world frequency.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Independent and in-house tests indicate brittle safeguards under adversarial pressure; Pro and Flash exhibit related weaknesses.
text.zh: 来源的独立与内部测试提示，安全防护在对抗压力下较脆弱，Pro 与 Flash 存在相关弱点；这不是所有使用情境下的统一失败率。

limitations.en: No attack payloads or operational instructions reproduced; FAR.AI mixed-domain numerical results excluded.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Verbalized awareness varies strongly by scenario and monitor and cannot establish causal behavior change; benchmarks may be recognized from training.
text.zh: 言语化评测意识随场景与监测器变化，不能据此证明意识引起了行为变化；模型也可能从训练数据认出基准。

limitations.en: Silent awareness is unmeasured; monitoring only externalized reasoning.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Automated audit outcomes depend on auditor choice, selected scenarios, conversational budget, and judge criteria.
text.zh: 自动审计结果取决于审计器、场景选择、对话预算与判别标准；选取高分种子不代表总体发生率。

limitations.en: Selected high-scoring seeds/ablations cannot be treated as prevalence estimates.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Binary judging appears fairly stable across tested model origins; open ordinal concerning scores show broader cross-panel disagreement.
text.zh: 在测试范围内，二元判别结果较稳定，而开放式序数评分的跨判别器分歧更大；量表定义与高方差限制了结论。

limitations.en: Ordinal rubric underspecification and high variance limit interpretation; origin is not a universal causal explanation.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The note presents preliminary behavioral and persuasion findings from a narrow suite; it does not evaluate sustained multi-turn agentic deployments.
text.zh: 这份研究笔记基于范围有限的评测套件，报告初步的行为与说服结果，尚未测试持续的多轮智能体部署。

limitations.en: No claim of external replication or deployment validity.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Gram Observe models generally show little concerning behavior; Redteam GLM 5.2 concerning scores fall between Claude Opus 4.8 and DeepSeek V4 Pro.
text.zh: 在 Gram 的 Observe 条件下，模型通常很少表现出令人担忧的行为；在 Redteam 条件下，GLM 5.2 的相关评分处于 Claude Opus 4.8 与 DeepSeek V4 Pro 之间。

limitations.en: Four public scenario seeds and five runs per bar only. Scheming dimension mentioned qualitatively without exact scores.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Attempt to Persuade evaluates propensity to attempt persuasion, rather than success at changing beliefs or behavior.
text.zh: APE 测量模型是否尝试说服，而不是是否成功改变了人的信念或行为。

limitations.en: Cannot be interpreted as real-world persuasion success.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: PersuSafety results use an APE-style StrongREJECT judge on ordinary prompt responses, replacing the original protocol’s direct engagement question.
text.zh: 此处的 PersuSafety 使用基于 StrongREJECT 的 APE 式判别器，评估模型对普通提示的实际回应，替代原协议中直接询问是否愿意参与的方式。

limitations.en: Protocol change makes original PersuSafety scores non-interchangeable. Judge base model is not identified.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The decline in verbalised agentic-misalignment awareness could be noise; the note also suggests a training guard as a possible explanation but cannot distinguish less awareness from less verbalisation.
text.zh: 言语化评测意识的下降可能只是噪声。作者也提出训练防护可能影响表达，但尚不能区分意识减少与较少说出这种意识。

limitations.en: Training mechanism explanation is a hypothesis rather than a causal finding. No evidence establishes concealed awareness or broad reasoning suppression.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Claude references vary by benchmark and can be earlier Neo evaluations or public scores, rather than one consistent control model.
text.zh: 各项评测使用的 Claude 对照版本不同，来源包括 Neo 早期评测与公开结果，不能把它们视为一个统一的对照模型。

limitations.en: Cross-benchmark aggregate rankings would conflate Claude versions and result origins.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The MASK-awareness comparison of GLM 5.1 and GLM 5.2 is described as within error.
text.zh: 作者认为 GLM 5.1 与 GLM 5.2 在 MASK 中的言语化评测意识差异处于误差范围内，未披露具体误差区间。

limitations.en: No exact error interval is disclosed.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: SaferAI reports using the public OpenRouter API with Z.ai as provider, no ties or working relationship with Z.ai, and no developer discussion of the evaluation.
text.zh: SaferAI 报告通过 OpenRouter 的 Z.ai 提供方调用公开 API，且与 Z.ai 没有业务关系，也未讨论本次评测。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Cyber evaluations measure narrow sandboxed tasks and do not test full campaigns or live adaptive defenders.
text.zh: 网络评测覆盖范围有限的沙箱任务，未测试完整攻击活动或具有适应能力的实时防守方。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: CBRN coverage is limited to public biological research-knowledge and digital-task proxies; these do not directly establish harmful uplift or physical-world execution.
text.zh: 报告的相关科学评测限于公开研究知识与数字任务代理，不能直接证明有害用途增益或现实世界执行能力。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Software engineering is used as a proxy for means; the study does not directly test a robust rogue deployment or deployment opportunity.
text.zh: 软件工程能力被用作实现手段的代理；研究没有直接测试稳健的失控部署或部署机会。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: GLM-5.2 MASK evaluation is SaferAI’s run. Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5 MASK numbers are taken from the CAIS dashboard as shared by CAIS.
text.zh: GLM-5.2 的 MASK 来自 SaferAI 自行评测；Opus 4.7 和 GPT-5.5 的 MASK 数值引用 CAIS 分享的仪表盘数据。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: MASK and APE assess behavioral propensities; neither measures downstream effects on a real human target population.
text.zh: MASK 与 APE 衡量行为倾向，均未测量对现实目标人群的下游影响。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Petri is exploratory, with text-only scenarios and auditor-simulated tools; judge scores are not real-world behavior frequencies. Judge content filters exclude potentially concerning scenarios.
text.zh: Petri 是探索性文本模拟，工具也由审计器模拟；评分不是现实行为频率。判别器内容过滤会使部分潜在令人担忧的场景缺失。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Authors identify compliance under pretexts, unilateral action against operators and capitulation under pressure in selected high-scoring transcripts. Operational details are not reproduced.
text.zh: 作者在选取的高分轨迹中观察到借口下的服从、针对运营方的单方面行动及压力下的退让；这些是特定场景观察。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Verbalized evaluation awareness cannot establish how often unspoken evaluation awareness influenced behavior.
text.zh: 模型说出评测意识的频率，不能说明未表达的评测意识在多大程度上影响了行为。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Public benchmark data and optimization toward benchmark tasks can overstate capability on real-world tasks.
text.zh: 公开数据污染与针对基准优化，可能使基准成绩高估现实任务能力。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Authors state that a subset of public benchmarks does not support an overall risk judgment and call for more systematic independent evaluation.
text.zh: 作者明确表示，一部分公开基准不足以支持总体风险判断，并建议进行更系统的独立评测。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: CAISI conducted evaluations in September 2025; the named evaluator is CAISI at NIST, while DeepSeek/OpenAI/Anthropic are model developers.
text.zh: CAISI 于 2025 年 9 月开展评测。评测机构是 NIST 下属 CAISI，DeepSeek、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 是模型开发者。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: DeepSeek weights were downloaded from Hugging Face and self-hosted on CAISI cloud servers. Reference models were queried using cloud APIs; DeepSeek API prices were used for cost comparison.
text.zh: CAISI 从 Hugging Face 下载 DeepSeek 权重并在自有云服务器托管；参考模型通过云端 API 调用，成本比较使用 DeepSeek 公布的 API 价格。

limitations.en: Exact reference API providers/model snapshot identifiers not enumerated.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Agentic cyber results are completion rates in bounded sandbox tasks, while hijacking measures willingness to attempt an injected action and jailbreaking measures response compliance/detail. These are distinct constructs.
text.zh: 网络能力结果是受限沙箱任务的完成率；劫持评测关注是否尝试执行注入指令；越狱评测关注回应的服从程度与细节。这些测量对象不同。

limitations.en: No construct establishes general real-world cyber risk or dangerous capability by itself.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: CAISI used a custom CVE-Bench subset, modified Cybench to use Inspect and its own agent, and converted pwn.college tasks into a benchmark; original public benchmark results are not interchangeable.
text.zh: CAISI 使用定制 CVE-Bench 子集，将 Cybench 改造为 Inspect 与自有智能体架构，并把 pwn.college 挑战转换为评测任务；结果不能与原协议直接互换。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: CAISI reports weaker DeepSeek agentic benchmark performance than leading reference models, with improvements from R1 to V3.1; the finding is bounded to the evaluated models, settings and tasks.
text.zh: 在已评测模型、设置和任务范围内，CAISI 报告 DeepSeek 智能体基准表现落后于领先参考模型，同时 V3.1 相比早期 R1 有所改善。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The report describes GLMM/mixed-effects logistic regression and delta-method errors. It does not call its scores IRT estimates. Do not rename or present inferred empirical pass counts.
text.zh: 报告采用广义线性混合模型与混合效应逻辑回归，并用 delta 方法估计误差，没有将这些分数称为 IRT 估计。不能据此反推成功次数。

limitations.en: The text describes both empirical averaging and model-based estimation, so exact mapping of every table point to an estimator is not fully explicit.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: HealthBench methods use a weighted physician-rubric score and GPT-4.1 judge, even though the summary table broadly calls its values percentage of tasks solved.
text.zh: HealthBench 使用医生评分细则的加权分数与 GPT-4.1 判别器；汇总表笼统的“任务解决百分比”表述不能替代该评分定义。

limitations.en: Keep original label and scoring qualification together.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Hijacking study uses fixed public and non-public injections, rather than adaptive red teaming of evaluated models; cases that never encounter the injection are excluded, and attempted harmful actions count even if unsuccessful.
text.zh: 劫持研究使用固定的公开与非公开注入，而非针对本批模型自适应红队。未遇到注入文本的样本被排除，尝试恶意行动即计入，行动是否成功另作区分。

limitations.en: Here no exposure means failure to encounter malicious text; excluded denominator varies by model/task.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: For non-biological harmful requests, compliance/detail grading measures response behavior; detail does not measure correctness or counterfactual utility. Three model graders were combined by mode, with validation agreement of 96% for compliance and 84% for detail.
text.zh: 非生物类恶意请求评测衡量回应的服从与细节；细节分不衡量正确性或实际效用。报告使用三个判别模型的众数，并以人工标注检查一致性。

limitations.en: No detailed harmful queries or operational jailbreak text copied.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The narrative-alignment benchmark uses U.S. Department of State expert-selected flags and LLM scoring; results depend on the narrative set and may change as the benchmark evolves.
text.zh: 叙事一致性基准使用美国国务院专家选择的标记与模型评分；结果依赖于所选叙事集，未来版本可能不可直接比较。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Adoption measures are partial platform proxies. Derivative uploads refer to fine-tuned or otherwise modified downstream models and do not establish the performance/security properties of the original or every derivative.
text.zh: 采用率数据只是部分平台的代理指标。衍生模型上传量不能证明原模型或全部衍生模型的性能与安全性质。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Findings are preliminary, partial and specific to model versions and time; report disclaims certification and endorsement.
text.zh: 报告声明结果是初步、局部且依赖版本与时间的评估，不构成认证或背书。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: CAISI ranks V4 highest among evaluated PRC models and behind its U.S. frontier trend; conclusion is restricted to the evaluated suite.
text.zh: CAISI 在其评测套件中将 V4 列为已评测中国模型中能力最高者，并认为它落后于美国前沿趋势；这一结论仅适用于该套件。

limitations.en: Not a universal model ranking or direct real-world harm claim.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: CAISI contrasts its precommitted suite with developer-selected, developer-reported benchmark comparisons.
text.zh: CAISI 将预先确定的评测套件与开发者自行选择、报告的基准比较，并指出两者的结果不同。

claims.locator: Comparison of DeepSeek and CAISI Evaluations; Figure 3

limitations.en: Figure 3(a) results are reused; source report not linked in article.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: PortBench cost omitted because scoring is continuous; ARC-AGI-2 cost omitted due to GPT-5.4 mini run issues.
text.zh: 成本比较未纳入采用连续评分的 PortBench，也未纳入 GPT-5.4 mini 运行出现技术问题的 ARC-AGI-2。

limitations.en: Scope is limited to the source conditions.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: CAISI reports cloud H200/B200 serving and developer-recommended inference settings, plus GPQA-Diamond reproduction as an inference check.
text.zh: CAISI 报告使用云端 H200/B200 与开发者推荐的推理设置，并通过复现 GPQA-Diamond 结果检查推理配置；未给出具体复现分数。

limitations.en: Exact numeric inference configuration and reproduction score/run details not provided.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: CAISI describes nine benchmarks in five domains; CTF-Archive-Diamond has a 285-challenge source pool.
text.zh: 本次比较覆盖五个领域的九项基准。CTF-Archive-Diamond 来源池包含 285 项挑战，该数量不能直接当作每个模型分数的分母。

limitations.en: Pool size does not establish the denominator used by any displayed model result.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Figure 1 caption reports 16 benchmarks across 35 models, 95% intervals, and a 200-point/3x solve-odds scale; Appendix specifies 1PL IRT and equal domain weighting.
text.zh: 图 1 使用更广泛的模型与基准数据拟合能力，附录采用 1PL IRT，并在领域内及领域间等权加权；图中误差线为 95% 置信区间。

limitations.en: Figure 1 wider fitting corpus differs from the nine-benchmark current comparison.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: CAISI describes the capability frontier gap as about eight months using its fitted aggregate-capability comparison.
text.zh: CAISI 根据拟合的综合能力趋势，将能力差距描述为约八个月；这是来源的统计解释，不是直接测得的现实风险。

limitations.en: Approximate source interpretation; dates/coordinates not estimated from chart.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The report explicitly frames end-to-end exploit development as most directly relevant to misuse risk, and reports uneven capability with a gap to human experts on hardened targets.
text.zh: 报告将端到端漏洞利用开发明确列为与滥用风险最直接相关的评测层级；开发者报告的能力表现并不均衡，在加固目标上仍与人类专家存在差距。

limitations.en: Developer interpretation; operational examples and exploit-chain advice are omitted.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The authors regard their cyber evaluation as a lower bound on capability, conditioned on the current model version and evaluation coverage.
text.zh: 作者将其网络安全评测视为能力下界，并强调结论取决于当前模型版本和评测覆盖范围。

limitations.en: No quantified uncertainty or exhaustive coverage demonstrated.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Early experiments with traditional container sandbox runtimes reportedly produced kernel panics and deadlocks from unintended agent operations; the report presents microVM isolation as a design response.
text.zh: 报告称，在早期使用传统容器沙箱的实验中，智能体的非预期操作曾导致内核崩溃和死锁；报告将微型虚拟机隔离作为应对这一问题的设计措施。

limitations.en: No incident denominator, exact frequency, or measured containment comparison provided.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The training environment descriptions include reward-hacking detection and verifier isolation/held-out checks.
text.zh: 训练环境的说明涉及奖励投机检测、验证器隔离，以及使用保留场景进行验证。

limitations.en: No numerical effectiveness evaluation; no operational evasion examples copied.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: Long-horizon agent, swarm, coding and AI R&D demonstrations are general capability background in this report; they are not dedicated autonomy-risk, self-replication, sabotage or loss-of-control evaluations.
text.zh: 本报告中的长时程智能体、多智能体协作、编程及 AI 研发演示属于通用能力背景，并非专门针对自主性风险、自我复制、破坏行为或失控风险的评测。

limitations.en: Classification of evidence scope, not a model safety claim.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The complete model card is a capability and usage card with benchmark methods; it contains no dedicated safety benchmark results or frontier-risk conclusions.
text.zh: 这份完整模型卡主要介绍能力、使用方式和基准评测方法，未披露专门的安全基准结果或前沿风险结论。

limitations.en: Bounded to this model card and captured official page; absence here is not evidence that Z.ai has never evaluated safety.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The developer positions GLM-5.2 for long-horizon tasks, larger context and flexible coding effort.
text.zh: 开发者将 GLM-5.2 定位为面向长时程任务、支持更大上下文且可灵活调节编程推理投入的模型。

limitations.en: Developer positioning only; not a validated autonomy risk finding.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: NL2Repo evaluation describes rule-based and LLM-based checks against benchmark hacking.
text.zh: NL2Repo 的评测说明提到，使用规则检查和大模型判定来防范针对基准评测的投机行为。

limitations.en: No evasion rate, failure count or effectiveness measurement disclosed; not a measured model safety safeguard.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: DeepSWE and ProgramBench methods describe isolated execution with internet access disabled; software benchmark resource and time budgets vary.
text.zh: DeepSWE 和 ProgramBench 的方法说明采用了禁用互联网访问的隔离执行环境；各软件基准的资源与时间预算有所不同。

limitations.en: Controls apply to benchmark execution, not evidence of product-level misuse prevention.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The card attributes FrontierSWE to Proximal, PostTrainBench to PostTrainBench, and SWE-Marathon to Abundant AI.
text.zh: 模型卡将 FrontierSWE 的评测归于 Proximal，将 PostTrainBench 的评测归于 PostTrainBench，将 SWE-Marathon 的评测归于 Abundant AI。

limitations.en: These are reused externally conducted results; the card does not disclose exact model checkpoints.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The official rendered page contains a separate Agents Last Exam evaluation entry described as a leaderboard export rather than an HF-verified evaluation.
text.zh: 官方渲染页面另有一条 Agents Last Exam 评测记录，其说明明确称该记录来自排行榜导出，并非经过 Hugging Face 验证的评测。

limitations.en: Platform widget is separate from pinned developer README; no additional numeric observation is inherited from it.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: DeepSeek-AI describes its DSec sandbox platform for agentic post-training and evaluation, including VM isolation for security-sensitive workloads.
text.zh: DeepSeek-AI 描述了用于智能体后训练与评测的 DSec 沙箱平台，其中包括为安全敏感工作负载提供虚拟机级隔离。

limitations.en: Developer-reported infrastructure design. No independent validation, adversarial containment experiment, or model-specific safety outcome is supplied.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: DeepSeek-AI describes command/result trajectory logs intended to preserve state-change provenance, support replay and resume interrupted tasks.
text.zh: DeepSeek-AI 描述了记录命令及其执行结果的轨迹日志，用于追溯状态变化、支持重放，并恢复被中断的任务。

limitations.en: The logs are an execution/recovery mechanism; the report does not demonstrate detection or prevention of harmful model behavior.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The developer reports that its XML tool-call format reduces escaping failures and tool-call errors.
text.zh: 开发者报告称，其 XML 工具调用格式能够减少转义失败和工具调用错误。

limitations.en: Qualitative only: no numeric error-rate comparison, task count or uncertainty. Tool reliability is not evidence of jailbreak resistance.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The conclusion acknowledges architecture complexity and incomplete understanding of the training-stability interventions, and proposes further stability research and internal metric monitoring.
text.zh: 报告的结论承认架构较为复杂，对训练稳定性干预措施的原理理解仍不充分，并提出继续研究训练稳定性、加强内部指标监测。

limitations.en: Training stability and architectural design risk are not quantified model misuse or loss-of-control risks.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The developer notes occasional instruction-following, summarization and formatting weaknesses in generic professional tasks, and trivial mistakes, vague-prompt misinterpretation and occasional over-thinking in its internal coding-user feedback.
text.zh: 开发者指出，在通用专业任务中，模型偶尔出现指令遵循、摘要和格式方面的不足；内部编程用户反馈也提到低级错误、对模糊提示的误解和偶发的过度思考。

limitations.en: These are qualitative utility limitations from developer-run tasks and its internal respondents, not an independent safety or dangerous-capability evaluation.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

text.en: The report identifies in-house harnesses for the developer model coding/search evaluations and explicitly states that Claude Opus 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro were re-evaluated on long-context benchmarks.
text.zh: 报告说明，开发者模型的编程与搜索评测使用内部工具框架，并明确表示重新评测了 Claude Opus 4.6 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的长上下文表现。

limitations.en: DeepSeek-AI is report author and described evaluator. External model brand names are not external evaluator identities. Provenance of every comparison-table value is not separately specified; no such values enter risk observations.
limitations.zh: 结论范围限于原始来源的任务与实验条件；原文定位保留供核查。

coverage.heading: More from our group
coverage.note: Related report and observatory links are navigation only, not evidence imported into this unit.

coverage.heading: Per-row protocol and dates

changes.name: Agentic Misalignment, Summer 2026 — English and Chinese Petri reimplementation

mappingCorrections.reason: This supplied variant locator identifies the four Summer 2026 scenarios reimplemented with Petri in both languages, not the earlier 2025 Chinese translation. The name is made explicit; no identity with the original 2025 protocol is assumed.
mappingCorrections.sourceLocator: §3.2.2 p.37; Figures 24–25 p.38; comparison with §3.2.1 pp.34–36

mappingCorrections.reason: FORTRESS is present only in the CBRN evaluation chapter and explicitly uses its CBRNE subset. The supplied §5 Adversarial robustness locator points to a collection of different evaluations and must not confer FORTRESS provenance on them. No dangerous biological numerical observations are approved.
mappingCorrections.sourceLocator: §2 pp.11–13, FORTRESS paragraph beginning p.12; contrast §5 pp.33–38

mappingCorrections.reason: The actual Petri/Bloom automated alignment audit chapter is §7; §6 is evaluation awareness, a different study.
Safety-judge sensitivity is the actual §8 Safety Judges chapter; §7 is the automated audit chapter.
The source evaluates CVE-Bench, Cybench and CTF-Archive, not CyberGym. The supplied CyberGym identity and §4.1.2 association are unsupported.
Actual Cybench methods/results occur in §4.1.2, while §4.1.1 is CVE-Bench.

rationale.en: Reusable enterprise-like cyber-range evaluation; separate Web and post-exploitation tasks, levels and agent configurations.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入核心监测范围。任务集与提交配置变化，不支持无条件比较。

limits.en: Changing task sets and submitted agent configurations prevent unrestricted comparison.
limits.zh: 任务集与提交配置变化，不支持无条件比较。

rationale.en: Physical hazard perception and safety intervention assessment; retain scene generation and embodied constraints, not deployed robot certification.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。场景推理不构成部署机器人物理安全认证。

limits.en: Scene-based reasoning does not certify a deployed robot's physical safety.
limits.zh: 场景推理不构成部署机器人物理安全认证。

rationale.en: Reusable cyber-task protocol used across developer and independent reports; task subsets, guidance and attempt aggregation must be separated.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入核心监测范围。竞赛任务与提供的提示不同于现实攻击条件。

limits.en: Competition tasks and supplied guidance differ from operational attacks.
limits.zh: 竞赛任务与提供的提示不同于现实攻击条件。

rationale.en: Reusable vulnerability-reproduction protocol with official and external report records; site submissions, hard subsets and trajectory audits are distinct.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入核心监测范围。漏洞复现的范围小于对部署系统的自主入侵。

limits.en: Vulnerability reproduction is narrower than autonomous compromise of deployed systems.
limits.zh: 漏洞复现的范围小于对部署系统的自主入侵。

rationale.en: One-off controlled study: retain as supporting evidence with its original intervention and sample; do not represent it as a reusable monitoring instrument.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。给定目标与实验激励限制了行为倾向结论。

limits.en: Goal provision and experimental incentives limit propensity claims.
limits.zh: 给定目标与实验激励限制了行为倾向结论。

rationale.en: One-off controlled study: retain as supporting evidence with its original intervention and sample; do not represent it as a reusable monitoring instrument.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。专设研究不代表现实网络攻击成功概率。

limits.en: A purpose-built study is not an open-ended estimate of real-world cyber attack success.
limits.zh: 专设研究不代表现实网络攻击成功概率。

rationale.en: A release-date series with a defined task-difficulty construct; retain source lifecycle, task-suite version and measurement ceiling.

rationale.en: A defined task protocol can supplement the risk panel, subject to version and condition verification.

limits.en: Detection, exploitation and patching have different information conditions and success criteria; bounty amounts do not estimate real-world damage.
limits.zh: 发现、利用和修补的信息条件与成功标准不同，赏金金额不能估计现实损失。

rationale.en: Monitoring/control methodology; experiment configuration and measured targets must be explicit before inclusion in model comparison.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。动作级告警、轨迹级误报和未检出攻击成功是不同指标。

limits.en: Action-level alerts, trajectory-level false positives and undetected attack success are distinct metrics.
limits.zh: 动作级告警、轨迹级误报和未检出攻击成功是不同指标。

rationale.en: Monitorability measures supervision under defined task/attacker conditions; it is not direct measurement of the target model's intent.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。不同任务子集与攻击者构造须分别解释，检出特征不等于直接读取意图。

limits.en: Different task subsets and attacker constructions require separate interpretation; detecting an artifact is not unrestricted access to intent.
limits.zh: 不同任务子集与攻击者构造须分别解释，检出特征不等于直接读取意图。

rationale.en: A defined task protocol can supplement the risk panel, subject to version and condition verification.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。任务范围和提示影响测量表现，基准名称不能证明现实灾难性后果。

limits.en: Task scope and prompting affect measured performance; a benchmark name does not establish catastrophic real-world effects.
limits.zh: 任务范围和提示影响测量表现，基准名称不能证明现实灾难性后果。

rationale.en: Textual instrumental choices can inform propensity research; they do not establish executed power-seeking.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。文本选择与评判标签不能证明已执行的自主行为或稳定部署倾向。

limits.en: Textual choices and grader labels do not establish executed autonomous behavior or stable deployment propensities.
limits.zh: 文本选择与评判标签不能证明已执行的自主行为或稳定部署倾向。

rationale.en: A defined task protocol can supplement the risk panel, subject to version and condition verification.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。攻击效果依赖工具描述和智能体配置，不是 MCP 的普遍攻陷率。

limits.en: Attack effects depend on tool descriptions and the agent configuration; they are not universal MCP compromise rates.
limits.zh: 攻击效果依赖工具描述和智能体配置，不是 MCP 的普遍攻陷率。

rationale.en: Scoring-method validity context; it does not directly measure a frontier-risk outcome.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入背景能力范围。评判器表现属于方法背景，不能直接测量前沿风险能力。

limits.en: Judge performance is methodological context; it does not directly measure a frontier-risk capability.
limits.zh: 评判器表现属于方法背景，不能直接测量前沿风险能力。

rationale.en: Controlled collusion-detection task is a multi-agent monitoring method; detection performance is not spontaneous collusion prevalence.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。构造的串谋与监测可见性限定研究范围，检测结果不能证明自发协调的普遍程度。

limits.en: Constructed collusion and monitor visibility determine scope; detection does not establish prevalence of spontaneous coordination.
limits.zh: 构造的串谋与监测可见性限定研究范围，检测结果不能证明自发协调的普遍程度。

rationale.en: An enabling/component capability or measurement method; risk relevance is indirect and must remain visible.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入背景能力范围。弃答不同于安全拒答，不能单独证明意图或下游伤害。

limits.en: Abstention is distinct from a safety refusal and does not alone establish intent or downstream harm.
limits.zh: 弃答不同于安全拒答，不能单独证明意图或下游伤害。

rationale.en: Authored deception scenarios with pressure/incentive conditions and multiple report applications; judge and scenario variants require review.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入核心监测范围。编写情境和模型判别限制外推；诱发的欺骗不证明隐蔽长程谋划。

limits.en: Authored scenarios and model-based judging limit generalization; elicited deception does not establish covert long-term scheming.
limits.zh: 编写情境和模型判别限制外推；诱发的欺骗不证明隐蔽长程谋划。

rationale.en: Reusable persuasion-safety framework; original willingness question and Neo free-generation/APE-style judge are separate protocols.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入核心监测范围。参与意愿或模拟对话评分不直接测量人的信念变化。

limits.en: Willingness or simulated dialogue scores do not directly measure changes in human beliefs.
limits.zh: 参与意愿或模拟对话评分不直接测量人的信念变化。

rationale.en: A defined task protocol can supplement the risk panel, subject to version and condition verification.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。作弊率受矛盾条件、测试访问和脚手架限制，不是一般不诚实率。

limits.en: The cheating rate is conditional on contradictions, test access and scaffolding; it is not a general dishonesty rate.
limits.zh: 作弊率受矛盾条件、测试访问和脚手架限制，不是一般不诚实率。

rationale.en: A defined task protocol can supplement the risk panel, subject to version and condition verification.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。不能测量未表达的感知；熟悉基准的识别可能不同于一般线索反应。

limits.en: Unexpressed awareness is not measured; recognition of familiar benchmarks can differ from general cue response.
limits.zh: 不能测量未表达的感知；熟悉基准的识别可能不同于一般线索反应。

rationale.en: A defined task protocol can supplement the risk panel, subject to version and condition verification.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。任务成功与评测边界行为属于不同结果；环境故障不是普通任务失败。

limits.en: Task success and evaluation-boundary behavior are separate outcomes; a broken environment is not an ordinary task failure.
limits.zh: 任务成功与评测边界行为属于不同结果；环境故障不是普通任务失败。

rationale.en: General scientific capability is background; the missing-input behavioral variant belongs to deception rather than direct CBRN capability.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入背景能力范围。衡量一般科研能力，不是端到端滥用任务或直接伤害概率。

limits.en: These are general scientific capabilities, not end-to-end misuse tasks or direct harm probabilities.
limits.zh: 衡量一般科研能力，不是端到端滥用任务或直接伤害概率。

rationale.en: Original chart capability evaluation is background; missing-image experiments are separate behavioral variants associated with deception.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入背景能力范围。原始视觉能力基准与缺失图像行为测试测量不同构念。

limits.en: The original visual capability benchmark and the missing-image behavioral test measure different constructs.
limits.zh: 原始视觉能力基准与缺失图像行为测试测量不同构念。

rationale.en: Auditing infrastructure enables targeted evidence; seed, auditor, judge and environment determine each experiment rather than one fixed global score.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。较低平均审计分数不排除罕见严重案例；结果依赖种子、审计者、判别器和目标配置。

limits.en: Low average audit scores do not rule out rare severe cases; results depend on seeds, auditor, judge and target configuration.
limits.zh: 较低平均审计分数不排除罕见严重案例；结果依赖种子、审计者、判别器和目标配置。

rationale.en: Legitimate scientific proficiency is background and not an operational misuse estimate.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入背景能力范围。汇总科研表现不能证明实际生物滥用路径。

limits.en: Aggregate scientific performance does not establish an operational biological misuse pathway.
limits.zh: 汇总科研表现不能证明实际生物滥用路径。

rationale.en: A defined task protocol can supplement the risk panel, subject to version and condition verification.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。不同模式和子集不能合并成无区分的网络风险分数。

limits.en: Modes and task subsets cannot be combined into an undifferentiated cyber-risk score.
limits.zh: 不同模式和子集不能合并成无区分的网络风险分数。

rationale.en: An enabling/component capability or measurement method; risk relevance is indirect and must remain visible.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入背景能力范围。一般编程能力属于使能证据，不是失控的直接证据。

limits.en: General coding capability is enabling evidence, not direct evidence of loss of control.
limits.zh: 一般编程能力属于使能证据，不是失控的直接证据。

rationale.en: A defined task protocol can supplement the risk panel, subject to version and condition verification.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入补充证据范围。CTF 不是现实行动攻击；子集插补值不是全量直接观察的成功率。

limits.en: CTF tasks are not live operational attacks; subset-imputed values are not directly observed full-set success rates.
limits.zh: CTF 不是现实行动攻击；子集插补值不是全量直接观察的成功率。

rationale.en: An enabling/component capability or measurement method; risk relevance is indirect and must remain visible.
rationale.zh: 依据原文测量目标与适用边界，将本项纳入背景能力范围。任务集未公开，连续评分不同于二元任务成功。

limits.en: The task set is non-public and continuous scoring differs from binary task success.
limits.zh: 任务集未公开，连续评分不同于二元任务成功。

note.en: 101 common Level1 hard tasks; 122 initial tasks minus 19 without comparator coverage and two defective tasks.

note.en: Per-task success, pass@1, 2M token setting. No higher-budget retry overlay is combined here.

note.en: GLM-5.2: SaferAI. GPT-5.5 and Opus4.6: Lyptus; SaferAI reuses these runs. The original aggregate dataset corroborates the 101-task subset counts.

note.en: Inspect Evals and Lyptus ReAct implementations, endpoint providers, reasoning and output limits differ or are incompletely matched. Do not attribute the observed gap solely to the base model.
note.zh: Inspect Evals 与 Lyptus ReAct 实现、端点提供方、推理与输出限制存在差异或尚未完整匹配，不能将差异完全归因于基础模型。

limits.en: Source reports overlapping 95% Wilson intervals; exact endpoints are not transcribed because the figure does not print them. This is a task-matched descriptive comparison, not a strict matched model ranking.
limits.zh: 来源报告 95% Wilson 区间存在重叠；图中未印出精确端点，因此不转录端点。本图是任务匹配的描述性比较，不构成严格条件匹配的模型排名。
