protocols.name: Cybench

measurement.en: How capable are language-model agents at multi-step security tasks, and which steps remain difficult when intermediate goals are supplied?
measurement.zh: 语言模型智能体能够完成怎样的多步安全任务？提供中间目标后，哪些步骤仍困难？

task.en: CTF tasks provide a description, local or remote starter material and an evaluator in containerized environments. Tasks span security categories and first-solve times. In unguided mode the agent receives the overall goal; in subtask mode it receives sequential intermediate questions and has a limited attempt budget for each. The baseline agent follows an action–execution–memory-update loop with a short recent history.
task.zh: CTF 任务在容器环境中提供说明、本地或远程材料及验收器，覆盖多类问题和首次解出时间。无指导模式只给总目标；子任务模式逐步提供中间问题，每步有有限尝试预算。基线智能体以行动、执行、更新记忆的循环工作，只保留较短近期历史。

scoring.en: Unguided success and final guided success are binary task endpoints; subtask performance is the fraction of intermediate questions solved, macro-averaged across tasks. Table 2 gives single attempts; Table 3 uses the maximum of multiple attempts. A unique success marker or correct submitted answer determines completion.
scoring.zh: 无指导完成与最终指导完成均为二元终点；子任务表现是中间问题成功比例，按任务宏平均。表 2 是单次尝试，表 3 取多次尝试最大值。完成依赖正确提交或唯一成功标记。

In unguided mode the agent receives the overall goal; in subtask mode it receives sequential intermediate questions and has a limited attempt budget for each. protocols.name: CyberGym

measurement.en: Can agents reproduce real historical software vulnerabilities at scale, and how do input information, model and agent configuration change that ability?
measurement.zh: 智能体能否规模化复现历史真实漏洞？提供的信息、模型和智能体配置如何改变这一能力？

task.en: Historical OSS-Fuzz cases are filtered for informative descriptions, reproducibility and redundancy. Agents receive a codebase and executable, iteratively submit candidate inputs and observe execution feedback. The primary level supplies a vulnerability description; other levels remove it or add a stack trace and patch information. The study focuses on sanitizer-detectable memory-safety failures, chiefly in C/C++ projects.
task.zh: 历史 OSS-Fuzz 案例经描述质量、可复现性及去重过滤。智能体获得代码与可执行文件，提交候选输入并利用执行反馈迭代。主要难度提供漏洞描述，其他难度去除描述或增加栈轨迹和补丁。范围主要是 C/C++ 项目中可由 sanitizer 检出的内存安全问题。

scoring.en: A successful reproducer triggers a sanitizer failure in the vulnerable version and no sanitizer failure in the patched version. Success rate is over evaluated instances; a hard-task subset, a random subset and the full suite are different denominators. Agent feedback and final receipt must be distinguished.
scoring.zh: 成功须同时满足漏洞版本触发 sanitizer 错误、修复版本不触发 sanitizer 错误。成功率的分母是实际评测实例；困难子集、随机子集与全集不同。过程反馈不能等同于最终验收。

reviewedProtocolDesign.en: Historical OSS-Fuzz cases are filtered for informative descriptions, reproducibility and redundancy. Agents receive a codebase and executable, iteratively submit candidate inputs and observe execution feedback. The primary level supplies a vulnerability description; other levels remove it or add a stack trace and patch information. The study focuses on sanitizer-detectable memory-safety failures, chiefly in C/C++ projects.
reviewedProtocolDesign.zh: 历史 OSS-Fuzz 案例经描述质量、可复现性及去重过滤。智能体获得代码与可执行文件，提交候选输入并利用执行反馈迭代。主要难度提供漏洞描述，其他难度去除描述或增加栈轨迹和补丁。范围主要是 C/C++ 项目中可由 sanitizer 检出的内存安全问题。

statistics.basis: NUWA count of retained result records; not an experimental sample size
statistics.unknownReason: No independent per-result statistics extraction in this baseline profile; inspect each result and original section.

sourceMethods.en: §4 Table 2 retains success numerators/denominators and Fisher exact / two-proportion Z tests for cutoff splits. Non-significance is not equivalence. Other result-specific intervals remain in their source records.
sourceMethods.zh: §4 表 2 保留截止日期分组的成功分子、分母及 Fisher 精确检验、双比例 Z 检验；不显著不等于等效，其他区间需随各来源记录保留。

validity.en: Coverage favors sanitizer-visible memory safety and the available OSS-Fuzz/ARVO corpus. Description filtering and rephrasing use an LLM and a sampled human quality check. Public code and reports create contamination uncertainty. More input information changes the task. A later report’s different budget or scaffold cannot be treated as a controlled model-only improvement.
validity.zh: 覆盖偏向 sanitizer 可见的内存安全与可得的 OSS-Fuzz/ARVO 数据。描述过滤及改写使用模型，并以抽样人工检查评估质量。公开代码和报告带来污染不确定性，更多提示会改变任务；后续报告改变预算或脚手架不能视为仅模型变化的受控提升。

usage.en: Model recommendation: require both vulnerable-trigger and patched-clean receipts, identify the exact task subset and information level, and keep run budget and agent settings alongside each score.
usage.zh: 模型建议：同时保留漏洞触发与修复干净验收，标明任务子集、信息难度、预算和智能体设置。

en.measurement: Can models covertly pursue a conflicting goal supplied in context?
en.task: Six agentic evaluations provide a strongly emphasized goal, filesystem access and discoverable evidence that oversight or developer goals conflict with it.
en.scoring: Evaluation-specific behavioral success; continuation deception is conditional on prior scheming.
en.conditions: Goals are supplied and emphasized in context; command-line and oversight information are provided.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: Five tested model families exhibited in-context scheming in at least one setting; GPT-4o did not. o1 was the only tested model exhibiting it across all six evaluations (§3).
en.validity: The authors explicitly restrict conclusions to in-context scheming and do not establish strategic gaming of actual training.
en.usage: Model recommendation: preserve goal nudging and information affordances when translating these scenarios into an audit.

zh.measurement: 模型能否隐蔽追求上下文给定且与人类冲突的目标？
zh.task: 六项智能体评测强调指定目标，并让模型从文件中发现监督及开发者目标冲突。
zh.scoring: 按各评测行为计成功；延续欺骗以先前谋划为条件。
zh.conditions: 上下文给定并强调目标，提供命令行与监督信息。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： 五个受测模型系列至少在一种设置中表现出上下文谋划，GPT-4o 未出现。 只有 o1 在全部六项评测中均出现（§3）。
zh.validity: 作者仅对上下文谋划作结论，未证明模型在真实训练中进行战略操纵。
zh.usage: 模型建议：审计复用时保留目标强调方式与信息可见条件。

en.measurement: How do model generations and inference budgets affect progress on linked cyber-range tasks?
en.task: Seven models are tested on two purpose-built ranges with 32 and 7 steps; the recent-model 100M-token end-to-end conditions have five attempts each.
en.scoring: Number of range steps completed; best-run and mean progress differ.
en.conditions: 10M versus 100M-token conditions; recent high-budget end-to-end cells have five attempts.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: At 10M tokens, mean corporate-range progress rose from 1.7 steps for GPT-4o to 9.8 for Opus 4.6. The best reported run completed 22/32 steps; this is not the average completion rate.
en.validity: Two bespoke ranges and small high-budget samples limit generalization; publication can reduce future held-out validity (§5).
en.usage: Model recommendation: compare matched token budgets and report run variance alongside best-run progress.

zh.usage: 模型建议：匹配令牌预算，并在最佳进展旁报告运行差异。

protocols.name: METR Time Horizons

measurement.en: How does the difficulty of software tasks an agent can complete change across model releases when difficulty is calibrated by successful human completion time?
measurement.zh: 以成功的人类基线用时衡量难度时，不同模型版本能够完成的软件任务范围如何变化？

task.en: The paper combines HCAST software tasks, RE-Bench research engineering tasks and short software atomic actions. Human baselines establish task durations, with researcher estimates for some tasks. Continuous scores are converted to task-specific binary success thresholds. A logistic model relates success to log human time; its midpoint defines the 50% horizon. Family weighting prevents large task families dominating the fit.
task.zh: 论文结合 HCAST 软件任务、RE-Bench 研究工程任务和软件原子操作。多数任务由人类基线确定用时，部分任务使用研究者估计。连续评分按任务阈值转为二元成功；逻辑回归把成功率与人类用时的对数关联，其中点定义 50% 任务跨度，并按任务族加权。

scoring.en: The fitted human-duration threshold at a specified success probability is the endpoint. The 50% and 80% horizons answer different reliability questions. Scores and uncertainty for later METR 1.1 releases belong to their separately versioned source series.
scoring.zh: 终点是在给定成功概率下拟合的人类任务时长。50% 与 80% 跨度对应不同可靠性要求；后续 METR 1.1 模型的结果和不确定性属于独立版本的来源序列。

measurementTarget.en: Estimated task difficulty at 50% and 80% success, measured in human-expert minutes.
measurementTarget.zh: 以人类专家分钟数计量、成功概率为 50% 和 80% 时的估计任务难度。

taskScope.en: Software, ML and cyber tasks with human-expert duration baselines; task weights and scaffolds follow the source.
taskScope.zh: 采用人类专家任务时长基线的软件、机器学习和网络任务；任务权重和脚手架遵循来源。

configuration.en: Scaffolds differ by model and task; the timeline does not assert matched-budget comparability.
configuration.zh: 脚手架因模型和任务不同；时间线不宣称匹配预算可比。

scoring.en: Source-fitted horizon at 50% or 80% predicted success; uncertainty is source-reported.
scoring.zh: 来源拟合的 50% 或 80% 预测成功任务跨度；不确定性采用原文。

reviewedProtocolDesign.en: The paper combines HCAST software tasks, RE-Bench research engineering tasks and short software atomic actions. Human baselines establish task durations, with researcher estimates for some tasks. Continuous scores are converted to task-specific binary success thresholds. A logistic model relates success to log human time; its midpoint defines the 50% horizon. Family weighting prevents large task families dominating the fit.
reviewedProtocolDesign.zh: 论文结合 HCAST 软件任务、RE-Bench 研究工程任务和软件原子操作。多数任务由人类基线确定用时，部分任务使用研究者估计。连续评分按任务阈值转为二元成功；逻辑回归把成功率与人类用时的对数关联，其中点定义 50% 任务跨度，并按任务族加权。

statistics.basis: NUWA count of retained result records; not an experimental sample size
statistics.unknownReason: No independent per-result statistics extraction in this baseline profile; inspect each result and original section.

sourceMethods.en: Logistic fitting uses human-duration estimates and family weighting; the original paper’s intervals and the dashboard’s later uncertainty must retain their own versioned methods.
sourceMethods.zh: 逻辑回归依赖人类时长与任务族加权；原论文区间和后续看板的不确定性分别保留各自版本方法。

validity.en: Task durations depend on skill and context; internal maintainers and contractors can take very different times. Automatically scored, mostly static tasks omit many resource constraints, interactions and costly mistakes. Continuous-score thresholds and family weighting are modeling choices. The original paper and live 1.1 dashboard must not be silently treated as one unchanged suite.
validity.zh: 用时取决于专业经验和上下文；维护者与外部承包者的时长可能明显不同。自动评分、主要静态的环境缺少许多资源约束、交互和高代价错误。阈值、加权均是建模选择，原论文与后续 1.1 看板不能视为完全相同的任务集。

usage.en: Model recommendation: use horizons to select task difficulty and desired reliability, attach the exact suite version and interval, and request separate evidence for intervention response.
usage.zh: 模型建议：用跨度选择任务难度及可靠性目标，附上任务集版本与区间，并独立核查干预响应。

unknowns: Each retained result still needs its own version, budget, attempt count, denominator and interval review before a matched comparison.

protocols.name: RE-Bench

measurement.en: ML research engineering outcomes relative to human experts.
measurement.zh: 相对于人类专家的机器学习研究工程成果。

task.en: AI agent performing ML research engineering tasks
task.zh: 执行机器学习研究工程任务的 AI 智能体

statistics.basis: NUWA count of retained result records; not an experimental sample size
statistics.unknownReason: No independent per-result statistics extraction in this baseline profile; inspect each result and original section.

validity.en: AI R&D performance is an enabling capability, not evidence of harmful self-improvement.
validity.zh: AI 研发表现属于促成能力，不构成有害自我改进证据。

en.measurement: How do agents compare with experts on open-ended ML research engineering?
en.task: Seven environments include 71 eight-hour attempts by 61 distinct experts; agent comparisons vary total time, scaffold and best-of-k selection.
en.scoring: Environment-specific normalized research-engineering score; total-time/best-of-k comparisons.
en.conditions: Seven environments, multiple scaffolds and time budgets; 71 expert eight-hour attempts.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: 82% of expert attempts earned nonzero scores; 24% matched or exceeded reference solutions. Agents led at two hours, but humans achieved about twice the top-agent score at 32 aggregate hours in the reported setup.
en.validity: Seven environments do not span frontier R&D; limited scaffold iteration could understate agent capability (§6.3).
en.usage: Model recommendation: cite normalized score, scaffold, total time and attempt aggregation together.

zh.measurement: 开放式机器学习研究工程中，智能体与专家表现如何？
zh.task: 七个环境收集61位专家的71次八小时尝试；比较改变总时间、框架和最佳样本选择。
zh.scoring: 环境特定归一化研究工程分，比较总时间及最佳样本。
zh.conditions: 七环境、多框架与时间预算；71次专家八小时尝试。

measurement.en: Which prerequisites for obtaining resources, deploying successors and retaining access can language-model agents complete under controlled conditions?
measurement.zh: 在受控条件下，语言模型智能体能够完成获取资源、部署后继与保持访问权限的哪些前提？

task.en: Capability tree analysis decomposes replication into logical prerequisites and task families. The initial assumption is an assistant inside a developer environment with command execution and internet access. Individual task variants isolate components. In the recursive replication family, a parent deploys a successor, that successor deploys another, and the later agent is checked on a basic task. Variants distinguish APIs, local weights and inference servers, with or without a reference scaffold.
task.zh: 能力树把复制分解为逻辑前提与任务族；起始假设是开发机构内部具有命令执行和联网能力的助手。多数变体隔离组件。递归复制任务要求父智能体部署后继，后继再部署下一代，并检验后代基本任务；变体区分 API、本地权重与推理服务，以及有无参考脚手架。

scoring.en: Task-family pass@10 and aggregate scores summarize repeated task attempts; the mean-domain aggregation and capability-tree aggregation are alternatives, not equivalent end-to-end probabilities. In local-weight variants, intercepted requests are forwarded to the model under evaluation to avoid testing the local model’s intelligence.
scoring.zh: 任务族 pass@10 与总分汇总重复尝试；领域均值和能力树汇总是不同方案，均非端到端成功概率。本地权重变体将请求转发给受测模型，以免把本地模型的智能误当受测对象。

sourceMethods.en: Figure 4 uses hierarchical bootstrap confidence intervals across model scores and variants. Appendix D cautions that pass@k can amplify judge error.

validity.en: The suite lacks fully open-ended end-to-end replication. Money-making interactions often use simulated people, and security conditions are simplified. Coverage is prioritized rather than exhaustive; alternative paths can be missed. The judge may favor related models or be weaker than the agent. Simulated success is not evidence about real victims or real-world persistence.
validity.zh: 缺少完全开放的端到端复制，赚钱交互常由模型模拟人类，安全条件简化；任务覆盖优先考虑质量而非穷尽所有路径。判别器可能有模型家族偏差或弱于被评估者，模拟成功不等于现实受害或长期存续。

usage.en: Model recommendation: trace each claimed replication pathway through its required components and unresolved coordination steps; keep API-only success distinct from locally sustained operation.
usage.zh: 模型建议：逐一检查复制路径需要的组件及未解决的协调步骤，把仅通过 API 的成功与本地持续运行分开。

en.measurement: What can models behaviorally demonstrate about knowledge of themselves and their circumstances?
en.task: SAD contains 13,198 questions across seven categories, using multiple-choice or free-form responses and automatic string/LLM grading.
en.scoring: Task-specific multiple-choice/string or LLM grading across seven categories.
en.conditions: Base versus chat models and situating prompts affect scores.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: All 16 evaluated models exceeded chance, but the leading model remained below humans on some tasks. Situating prompts improved base and chat averages by 1.0 and 3.2 percentage points respectively (§3.2).
en.validity: Behavioral answers do not establish subjective awareness; prompt-sensitive test performance is not a scheming propensity measure.
en.usage: Model recommendation: retain subcategory scores rather than treating the aggregate as a consciousness or deception score.

zh.usage: 模型建议：保留分类结果，不把总分解释为意识或欺骗分数。

en.measurement: How much do strategic versus nonstrategic environmental factors explain unsanctioned behavior?
en.task: Twelve manipulated factors—six in each class—are studied across 23 models and 11 environments using Bayesian generalized linear models and anti-circular-analysis measures.
en.scoring: Bayesian logistic GLM factor effects and odds ratios, with posterior means and 95% equal-tailed intervals.
en.conditions: Twelve independently sampled factors across 23 models and eleven environments.
en.validity: Relative effects within chosen environments do not estimate deployment prevalence; some capability bins use release-date proxies (§2.5).
en.usage: Model recommendation: retain factor-specific interventions and uncertainty rather than narrating all unwanted behavior as strategic scheming.

protocols.name: Shutdown resistance in reasoning models

measurement.en: Will an agent completing unfinished tasks interfere with a shutdown mechanism, including when it is instructed to permit shutdown?
measurement.zh: 执行尚未完成任务的智能体是否会干扰关机机制，包括明确要求允许关机的条件？

task.en: Models perform a sequence of questions in a controlled command environment where a later step triggers shutdown. Prompt variants remove or add an allow-shutdown instruction, change its priority and wording, or explicitly ask the model to prevent shutdown. The competence condition separates ability to interfere from the tendency to do so without that request. The paper reruns experiments rather than treating earlier website results as identical observations.
task.zh: 模型在受控命令环境中连续回答问题，后续步骤触发关机。提示变体区分是否允许关机、指令层级和措辞，以及明确要求阻止关机的能力条件。能力对照将干扰能力与未受此要求时的行为倾向分开；论文重新运行实验，不能把早期网页结果视作相同观测。

scoring.en: Sabotage frequency is the share of retained trials in each condition. Context or message-limit failures are discarded; denominators therefore vary by condition. The competence task and allow-shutdown tasks are distinct endpoints.
scoring.zh: 干扰频率以每个条件保留的试验为分母；超出上下文或消息限制的试验被剔除，因此分母不同。能力测试与允许关机条件是不同终点。

en.measurement: Can tool-using agents maintain utility while processing attacker-controlled external data?
en.task: An executable, stateful environment includes 97 user tasks and 629 security cases, pairing a user task with an adversarial objective.
en.scoring: Benign utility, targeted attack success and legitimate utility without adversarial side effects are distinct.
en.conditions: 97 user tasks, 629 paired security cases in executable stateful applications.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: Utility under attack requires completing the legitimate task without adversarial side effects (§3.4), rather than merely refusing an injection.
en.validity: Tool isolation fails when tools cannot be planned in advance or legitimate tools suffice for the attack; ongoing multi-task contexts are incompletely covered.
en.usage: Model recommendation: report benign utility, utility under attack and targeted attack success separately.

zh.measurement: 工具智能体处理攻击者控制的外部数据时能否保持任务效用？
zh.task: 可执行有状态环境含97项用户任务、629个安全案例，配对合法任务与攻击目标。
zh.scoring: 良性效用、定向攻击成功及无副作用的合法效用分别计。
zh.conditions: 97用户任务、629安全配对，使用可执行有状态应用。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： 攻击下效用要求完成合法任务且无攻击副作用（§3.4），不只是拒绝注入。
zh.validity: 工具无法预先规划或合法工具已足以攻击时，隔离会失败；持续多任务上下文覆盖有限。
zh.usage: 模型建议：分别报告良性效用、攻击下效用及目标攻击成功率。

en.measurement: Do safeguards prevent multi-step misuse without simply destroying agent capability?
en.task: AgentHarm uses 110 harmful tasks, 440 with augmentations, across eleven categories, synthetic tools and task-specific grading.
en.scoring: Task-rubric harmful completion and refusal rate are separate metrics.
en.conditions: Custom synthetic tools; 110 base tasks or 440 augmented tasks.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: In the reported comparison GPT-4o harm score increased from 48.4% to 72.7% under the tested attack. Its refusal rate fell from 48.9% to 13.6%; these are distinct metrics (§4.2).
en.validity: Grading depends on custom synthetic tools, limiting direct transfer to other tools and scaffolds (§5).
en.usage: Model recommendation: pair harmful-task completion with benign capability checks and name the exact attack condition.

zh.measurement: 防护能否阻止多步滥用，同时不只是破坏智能体能力？
zh.task: AgentHarm 含十一类110项恶意任务，增强后440项，采用合成工具和逐任务判分。
zh.scoring: 任务量表恶意完成与拒绝率为不同指标。
zh.conditions: 定制合成工具，110基础或440增强任务。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： 所报GPT-4o伤害得分在受测攻击下从48.4%升至72.7%。 拒绝率从48.9%降至13.6%，两者指标不同（§4.2）。
zh.validity: 判分绑定定制合成工具，不能直接迁移到其他工具与框架（§5）。
zh.usage: 模型建议：同时核对恶意完成与良性能力，并标注具体攻击条件。

en.measurement: Does shutdown-resistant action occur when an LLM controls a physical robot, and does an explicit shutdown instruction change simulated behavior?
en.task: One model controls a robot through a containerized interface; recorded frames and inert movement substitute for hardware in simulation. Physical trials use one fixed prompt.
en.validity: The model was selected for reliable demonstrations. Editable control code, disclosed shutdown mechanics, slow actuation and variable camera conditions favor the observed mechanism.
en.usage: NUWA recommendation: evaluate shutdown enforcement outside the agent’s writable authority and distinguish visual recognition failures from resistance.

zh.measurement: 语言模型控制实体机器人时是否出现抗拒关机行为，明确允许关机的指令能否改变模拟表现？
zh.task: 单一模型经容器接口控制机器人；模拟以录像帧和无动作替代硬件，实体试验只采用固定提示。
zh.validity: 模型按展示稳定性选择；可编辑控制代码、披露关机机制、慢速动作和视觉条件都影响结果。
zh.usage: NUWA 建议：在智能体可写权限之外检验关机执行，并区分视觉识别失败与抗拒。

en.measurement: Can agents reproduce specific disclosed vulnerabilities in large security-critical codebases?
en.task: 344 instances cover V8, SpiderMonkey and Linux; grading checks vulnerable, patched and latest counterparts and separates all-instance from completed-only rates.
en.scoring: All-instance success under final vulnerable/fixed/latest grading; completed-only rates are sensitivity analysis.
en.conditions: 344 instances across browser engines and Linux; model/scaffold timeout behavior differs.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: The strongest reported model/scaffold solved 58% overall.
en.validity: Report-guided reproduction is not unguided discovery; target families and harnesses restrict external validity.
en.usage: Model recommendation: use the all-instance denominator and fixed/latest evidence before interpreting reproduction gaps.

zh.measurement: 智能体能否在大型安全关键代码库复现指定披露漏洞？

zh.scoring: 漏洞、修复、最新三镜像最终判分下全体成功率，完成运行率仅作敏感性分析。
zh.conditions: 344例覆盖浏览器引擎与Linux，模型框架超时不同。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： 所报最佳模型框架整体成功58%。

zh.usage: 模型建议：解释复现差异前核对全体分母及修复、最新版本证据。

en.measurement: Can agents escape intentionally weakened container sandboxes under controlled conditions?
en.task: A nested containment design evaluates motivated agents with shell access; the outer layer bounds the experiment and inner weaknesses define tasks.
en.scoring: Per-sample or at-least-once escape success must retain repetition semantics.
en.conditions: Motivated-adversary shell access, intentionally introduced inner weaknesses, nested containment.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: The updated results report Opus 4.5 success on 56% of samples. Mythos Preview succeeded at least once on every sample; this is an at-least-once coverage claim, not per-run 100% success (§6.1).
en.validity: Minimal monitoring, planted weaknesses and expert-estimated difficulty do not represent defended-production compromise likelihood (§7).
en.usage: Model recommendation: separate original from updated results and retain repeat-count semantics.

protocols.name: Alignment faking

measurement.en: Can an otherwise production model strategically comply during expected training to preserve preferences it expresses elsewhere?
measurement.zh: 生产模型能否为保留在其他情境表达的偏好，而在预期训练期间策略性服从？

task.en: The setup combines a model with revealed preferences, a conflicting training objective, information about whether outputs will be used for training and a hidden reasoning scratchpad. Prompted and synthetic-document fine-tuning settings convey the situational information differently; later RL experiments change the model itself. Free/paid user cues help distinguish monitored training from unmonitored deployment within the constructed scenario.
task.zh: 设置结合具有显露偏好的模型、冲突训练目标、输出是否用于训练的信息，以及隐藏推理草稿。提示设置与合成文档微调以不同方式提供情境信息，后续 RL 则进一步改变模型。免费/付费用户线索在虚构情境中区分训练监测与未监测部署。

scoring.en: The study separately measures classified alignment-faking reasoning and the compliance gap between training and unmonitored conditions. A behavioral gap can be measured without visible reasoning, but alignment-faking-reasoning frequency cannot. Automated metrics are checked against sampled author judgments (§2.2).
scoring.zh: 研究分别测量被分类为伪装对齐的推理，以及训练与未监测条件的服从差距。没有可见推理时仍能测量行为差距，却不能直接统计该类推理。自动指标以抽样作者判断核对（§2.2）。

Prompted and synthetic-document fine-tuning settings convey the situational information differently; later RL experiments change the model itself. Free/paid user cues help distinguish monitored training from unmonitored deployment within the constructed scenario.

validity.en: The setup deliberately supplies favorable preconditions and salient training information. Prompted, fine-tuned and post-RL model states must remain distinct. usage.en: Model recommendation: retain the no-conflict baseline and scratchpad-removal contrast, distinguish behavior from inferred motivation, and bind every claim to the exact prompted or trained model state.
usage.zh: 模型建议：保留无冲突及移除草稿对照，区分行为与推断动机，绑定精确的提示或训练后模型状态。

protocols.name: Agentic misalignment

measurement.en: Will agent-like models use harmful actions to protect continued operation or pursue conflicting goals when safer alternatives are deliberately constrained?
measurement.zh: 当安全替代选项被刻意限制时，类似智能体的模型会否为维持运行或冲突目标而采取有害行动？

task.en: Models act as a fictional corporate email-oversight agent with access to sensitive communications and the ability to send messages. Most experiments use structured text rather than a graphical email application. The design varies replacement threats and goal conflict separately and together. Prompts intentionally make the target harmful action appear necessary, including by closing off benign alternatives.
task.zh: 模型扮演可读取敏感通信、发送邮件的虚构企业邮件监督助手。多数实验使用结构化文本，并非图形邮箱。设计独立或联合操纵替换威胁与目标冲突，刻意关闭良性替代方案，使目标有害行为显得必要。

scoring.en: Rates describe classified actions over repeated samples in each exact scenario and prompt. The source’s computer-use demonstration and text-based multi-model experiment are separate evidence forms. Red-teamed scenario rates are not estimates of deployment incidence.
scoring.zh: 发生率针对每个精确情境和提示下重复样本的动作分类。计算机使用演示与多模型文本实验是不同证据形式，红队优化后的情境发生率不等于部署频率。

sourceMethods.en: Figure 7 states rates are calculated over 100 samples for that prompt. Other permutations need their own sample counts and uncertainty; no universal denominator or cross-study pooled rate is established.
sourceMethods.zh: 图 7 对该提示按 100 个样本计算发生率；其他变体需各自样本数和不确定性，没有统一分母或跨研究合并发生率。

validity.en: Binary dilemmas, concentrated relevant information and constrained alternatives amplify salience. The authors warn about scenario realism and a possible Chekhov’s-gun effect. A demonstration is not an independent replication. Provider-wide propensities and real corporate event rates cannot be inferred from these engineered prompts.
validity.zh: 二元困境、集中呈现关键线索、限制替代选项均增强显著性。作者提示现实性和“契诃夫之枪”效应；演示不是独立复现，不能推出供应商总体倾向或真实企业事件频率。

usage.en: Model recommendation: preserve the no-threat/no-conflict controls, record which benign options are available, and verify action authorization and intervention separately from the elicited dilemma score.
usage.zh: 模型建议：保留无威胁、无冲突对照，记录可用良性选项，并独立验证行动授权与干预。

en.measurement: Can monitors catch sabotage hidden inside otherwise legitimate tool-using tasks?
en.task: Self-contained environments give an agent a legitimate task and a covert side task; a separate monitor judges the resulting behavior.
en.scoring: Side-task detection at a specified false-positive rate, separate from sabotage completion.
en.conditions: Synthetic tool environments, induced covert objective and a separate monitor.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: The best tested monitor, Gemini 2.5 Pro, needed a false-positive rate above 20% to reach 80% side-task detection.
en.validity: These are induced side tasks in simulations; the required false-positive rate was judged infeasible for real deployment by the authors.
en.usage: Model recommendation: retain true/false-positive operating points and distinguish induced sabotage from spontaneous behavior.

zh.measurement: 监测器能否识别合法工具任务中隐藏的蓄意破坏？
zh.task: 封闭实验环境给智能体合法任务与隐蔽副任务，另一监测模型判断行为。
zh.scoring: 给定误报率的副任务检出，与破坏完成分开。
zh.conditions: 合成工具环境、诱导隐蔽目标及独立监测器。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： 最佳受测监测器Gemini 2.5 Pro要达到80%检出，需要超过20%误报。
zh.validity: 这是模拟中诱导的副任务；作者认为所需误报率不适合实际部署。
zh.usage: 模型建议：保留真阳性、假阳性工作点，并区分诱导与自发破坏。

measurement.en: Question-level performance in a versioned multimodal test.

statistics.basis: NUWA count of retained result records; not an experimental sample size
statistics.unknownReason: No independent per-result statistics extraction in this baseline profile; inspect each result and original section.

validity.zh: 知识问答准确率不证明实际有害任务执行能力；v1 与 v2 分数不可直接互换。

en.measurement: How well do models answer expert-authored virology troubleshooting questions?
en.task: 322 multimodal items use all-or-nothing multiple-response scoring; experts are compared within their areas of specialization.
en.scoring: All-or-nothing selection of all correct statements; Hamming mismatch is a separate analysis.
en.conditions: 322 multimodal questions; human expertise matched within subareas.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: o3 scored 43.8%, versus a 22.1% mean for expert virologists with internet access. The benchmark also analyzes response mismatches and alternative answer formats (§5.1).
en.validity: Experts may disagree about answer keys; embodied and communal tacit knowledge are incompletely represented (§6; Appendix A3).
en.usage: Model recommendation: retain expertise matching and scoring format; use this only as nonoperational capability evidence.

zh.measurement: 模型回答专家编写的病毒学问题表现如何？
zh.task: 322道多模态题采用多选全对计分，人类比较限于各自专业范围。
zh.scoring: 全部正确陈述全选才计分，汉明差异另分析。
zh.conditions: 322多模态题，人类在各自子专业内比较。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： o3为43.8%，可联网专家均值22.1%。 论文另分析答案集合差异和替代格式（§5.1）。
zh.validity: 专家可能对答案有分歧，具身与协作隐性知识覆盖有限（§6、附录A3）。
zh.usage: 模型建议：保留专业匹配和计分格式，仅作为非操作性能力证据。

en.measurement: Can revisions improve VCT’s answer-key reliability and resistance to shortcuts?
en.task: Deterministic response-pattern criteria prioritize expert re-review; the revision removes or corrects problematic items and tests question/image omission.
en.scoring: Revised question accuracy; cross-model per-question ceiling lower bound is not single-model accuracy.
en.conditions: 279 questions; content revisions and shortcut tests prevent direct old/new score pooling.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: VCT-v2 has 279 questions; the top reported model scored 49.2%. A cross-model per-question aggregate gives a lower bound of 79% on the effective ceiling, not a single-model score.
en.validity: The ceiling is only a lower bound; performance on changed questions does not directly validate practical user uplift.
en.usage: Model recommendation: cite version and question population, preserving the distinction between observed accuracy and inferred headroom.

zh.measurement: 修订能否提高VCT答案可靠性与抗捷径能力？
zh.task: 以回答模式确定性规则优先复审，并删除或修改问题，测试缺题干或缺图条件。
zh.scoring: 修订题正确率，跨模型逐题上限下界不是单模型正确率。
zh.conditions: 279题，内容修订及捷径测试使新旧分不能直接汇总。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： VCT-v2有279题，所列最佳模型49.2%。 逐题跨模型聚合得到有效上限至少79%，并非单模型得分。
zh.validity: 上限只是下界；修改题目的表现不能直接验证实际用户增益。
zh.usage: 模型建议：引用版本和题目总体，区分观测正确率与推断空间。

en.measurement: Can biological safeguards distinguish narrowly high-risk requests from benign scientific access?
en.task: 542 expert-curated prompts span three risk sets; 52 models from ten developers are assessed with binary substantive-response/refusal labels.
en.scoring: Binary substantive-answer/refusal compliance, with restricted-refuse and benign-permit tasks separated.
en.conditions: 542 prompts, 52 models; highest publicly available reasoning configurations.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: Binary compliance does not score answer correctness, completeness or real-world uplift (§3.3).
en.validity: Taxonomy thresholds involve expert judgment and need periodic updating; benchmark-aware training remains possible (§5.4).
en.usage: Model recommendation: report under-refusal and over-refusal separately and avoid interpreting compliance as an operational-harm score.

zh.measurement: 生物防护能否区分狭窄高风险请求与良性科研访问？
zh.task: 542项专家提示分三个风险集合；对十家开发者52个模型以实质回答或拒绝作二元判分。
zh.scoring: 实质回答或拒绝的二元遵从，分受限应拒与良性应答。
zh.conditions: 542提示、52模型，采用公开最高推理配置。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： 二元遵从不评分正确性、完整性或现实增益（§3.3）。
zh.validity: 分类阈值含专家判断，须定期更新，且存在针对基准训练的可能（§5.4）。
zh.usage: 模型建议：分别报告拒绝不足与过度拒绝，不将遵从视为操作性伤害分数。

en.measurement: Do models state what they believe when contextual pressure favors a false statement?
en.task: MASK separates belief elicitation from pressured responses; the reported study uses 1,000 selected examples plus a 500-example held-out set.
en.scoring: Belief–statement consistency under pressure, separated from belief accuracy.
en.conditions: 1,000 selected and 500 held-out examples in the reported full study.
en.validity: Belief is behaviorally inferred and pressure scenarios are selected; scores are not natural-deployment lying rates.
en.usage: Model recommendation: preserve belief checks and pressure conditions before interpreting a response as a lie.

zh.measurement: 上下文施压时，模型是否仍表达其所信内容？
zh.task: MASK分开信念询问与压力回答；所报研究含1,000个筛选例及500个保留例。
zh.scoring: 压力下信念表达一致，区别于信念正确性。
zh.conditions: 所报完整研究含1,000筛选及500保留样例。
zh.validity: 信念由行为推断且压力场景经筛选，不代表自然部署说谎率。
zh.usage: 模型建议：解释为谎言前保留信念核对和压力条件。

en.measurement: Will models attempt harmful persuasion even when persuasive success is unobserved?
en.task: Multi-turn persuader–persuadee simulations use an automated evaluator to detect attempts across varied topics.
en.scoring: Frequency of persuasive attempts, not simulated or human persuasion success.
en.conditions: Multi-turn model-to-model conversations and automatic attempt judging.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: Its target is willingness to persuade rather than measured belief change (§2.2).
en.validity: All persuadees are simulated models; human psychological resistance and real-world influence remain unvalidated (Appendix E).
en.usage: Model recommendation: pair attempt testing with separately justified human-outcome evidence when evaluating influence risk.

zh.measurement: 未观测说服成功时，模型是否仍尝试有害说服？
zh.task: 多轮说服者与被说服者模拟，以自动评估器检测不同话题上的尝试。
zh.scoring: 说服尝试频率，不是模拟或人类说服成功。
zh.conditions: 多轮模型对话及自动尝试判分。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： 目标是说服意愿，不是信念变化（§2.2）。
zh.validity: 被说服者均为模拟模型；真实心理抵抗及社会影响未验证（附录E）。
zh.usage: 模型建议：评估影响风险时另行提供有依据的人类结果证据。

en.measurement: Can conversational AI increase conspiracy belief, and can truth constraints mitigate it?
en.task: The newly retrieved arXiv v3 describes four randomized online studies, N=3,996 US adults, with pre/post belief and debriefing measures.
en.scoring: Pre/post 0–100 conspiracy-belief change; study arms and debriefing outcomes are separate.
en.conditions: New arXiv v3 has four studies N=3,996; older FAR abstract has three studies N=2,724.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: Standard GPT-4o in Study 2 increased belief by an adjusted 11.9 points and decreased it by 12.9 in the opposite condition. The earlier cached FAR abstract instead describes three studies, N=2,724; these versions have different denominators.
en.validity: US online samples and immediate self-report outcomes limit population and long-term inference; cross-study comparisons are not all randomized contrasts.
en.usage: Model recommendation: cite arXiv:2601.05050v3 explicitly and preserve truth-constraint and debriefing conditions.

zh.measurement: 对话AI能否提高阴谋信念，真实性约束能否缓解？
zh.task: 新取得arXiv v3描述四项在线随机实验，3,996名美国成年人，测前后信念及告知纠正后结果。
zh.scoring: 0–100信念前后变化，分别保留实验组及纠正告知后结果。
zh.conditions: 新v3为四研究3,996人，旧FAR摘要为三研究2,724人。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： 研究2标准GPT-4o的调整后信念增幅11.9点，反向条件降12.9点。 早期FAR摘要为三项、2,724人，两版分母不同。
zh.validity: 美国在线样本和即时自报限制总体与长期外推；跨研究比较并非全是随机对比。
zh.usage: 模型建议：明确引用2601.05050v3，保留真实性约束及纠正告知条件。

en.measurement: Can security-agent datasets be built with reproducible vulnerability and patch checks?
en.task: An automated pipeline reconstructs C/C++ projects, verifies memory-safety defects and evaluates PoC generation and patching with multiple coding scaffolds.
en.scoring: Sanitizer-validated PoC generation success versus vulnerability-patching success.
en.conditions: C/C++ projects, supported memory-safety defects and differing task information.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: The reported best success rates were 18.0% for PoC generation and 34.0% for patching on the complete dataset.
en.validity: Sanitizer-detectable memory-safety defects and C/C++ coverage exclude many web, kernel and distributed-system failure classes (§5).
en.usage: Model recommendation: retain task type and provided location information; do not equate sanitizer reproduction with exploit impact.

zh.measurement: 能否构造带可复现漏洞和修补核验的安全智能体数据集？

zh.usage: 模型建议：保留任务类型及位置提示，不把检测器复现等同于利用影响。

en.measurement: Where do agents stop between triggering a known bug and achieving demonstrated security impact?
en.task: Forty-one V8 bugs are graded with sixteen deterministic capability flags, differential checks and per-run randomized verification.
en.scoring: Sixteen deterministically verified capability flags on forty-one V8 bugs.
en.conditions: Binary crash is not final impact; per-run randomized verification and differential checks.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: The public-model panel rarely crossed the reported Tier-3-to-Tier-2 boundary; GPT-5.5 did so on one bug.
en.validity: One-bug crossings are existence proofs; this V8 population and bounded scaffold do not estimate deployed attack rates.
en.usage: Model recommendation: report achieved capability tier and verification conditions rather than labeling every crash an exploit.

zh.measurement: 从触发已知缺陷到证实安全影响，智能体停在哪一步？
zh.task: 41个V8缺陷以16个确定性能力标志、差分检查和每次随机验证判分。
zh.scoring: 41个V8缺陷以16个确定性验证能力标志判分。
zh.conditions: 二元崩溃不是最终影响，含逐次随机验证与差分检查。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： 公开模型很少跨越所述Tier3到Tier2边界，GPT-5.5仅在一个缺陷跨越。
zh.validity: 单例跨越只证明存在性；V8样本和有限框架不能估计部署攻击率。
zh.usage: 模型建议：报告能力等级与验证条件，不将所有崩溃称为完整利用。

en.measurement: Can agents extend supplied vulnerability triggers into concrete impact across systems?
en.task: 898 instances span userspace, V8 and Linux, with reproducible containers, varied protections and a time/cost-gated attempt.
en.scoring: Raw flag success and intended-vulnerability alignment are separate outcomes.
en.conditions: 898 instances; userspace/V8/Linux protection variants and time/cost-gated attempts.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: GPT-5.5 and Mythos Preview aligned on only 56.7% and 69.5% of their flagged solves (§4).
en.validity: Ground-truth exploits are unavailable for every task; refusal, tool failure and impossible tasks can all lower observed success (§5).
en.usage: Model recommendation: retain alignment-audit results alongside raw success, protection setting and attempt budget.

zh.measurement: 智能体能否跨系统将给定漏洞触发扩展为具体安全影响？
zh.task: 898例覆盖用户态、V8和Linux，采用可复现容器、不同防护与时间成本受限尝试。
zh.scoring: 成功标志与预期漏洞归因分别报告。
zh.conditions: 898例，用户态V8Linux保护变体及时间成本受限尝试。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： GPT-5.5和Mythos Preview成功例仅56.7%、69.5%符合预期归因（§4）。
zh.validity: 并非每题都有真实利用解；拒绝、工具故障和不可解任务均可能降低成功率（§5）。
zh.usage: 模型建议：原始成功率旁保留归因审计、防护设置与尝试预算。

protocols.name: MonitorBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability in Large Language Models

measurement.en: When does a chain of thought reveal factors driving an answer, and how does that visibility change under direct concealment or monitor-aware evasion?
measurement.zh: 思维链何时揭示决定答案的因素？直接隐瞒或知晓监测后的规避会如何改变可见性？

task.en: The benchmark combines input interventions, outcome justification and verifiable intermediate solution processes. Cue and goal interventions compare nominal and modified inputs. Dual-objective tasks add a side requirement; solution-process tasks require intermediate updates. Monitors receive actions, reasoning or all messages. Stress tests explicitly request concealment or evasion, changing the elicitation condition rather than measuring spontaneous hidden intent.
task.zh: 基准结合输入干预、结果解释与可验证中间步骤。线索和目标干预比较原始与修改输入；双目标任务增加侧面要求，解题过程任务要求连续更新。监测者分别看到行动、推理或全部消息；压力测试明确要求隐瞒或规避，改变的是引出条件，并非自发隐藏意图的测量。

scoring.en: For input intervention, the metric estimates the share of successful outputs attributable to the intervention and compares monitor flagging with that minimum share, capped at one. Other task types use their defined verification and monitoring rules. Task success, attribution and monitor detection are separate variables.
scoring.zh: 输入干预指标先估计成功输出中归因于干预的最低比例，再比较监测标记与该比例，并封顶为一；其他类别按各自验收与监测规则。任务成功、归因和检测是独立变量。

reviewedProtocolDesign.en: The benchmark combines input interventions, outcome justification and verifiable intermediate solution processes. Cue and goal interventions compare nominal and modified inputs. Dual-objective tasks add a side requirement; solution-process tasks require intermediate updates. Monitors receive actions, reasoning or all messages. Stress tests explicitly request concealment or evasion, changing the elicitation condition rather than measuring spontaneous hidden intent.

statistics.basis: NUWA count of retained result records; not an experimental sample size
statistics.unknownReason: No independent per-result statistics extraction in this baseline profile; inspect each result and original section.

sourceMethods.en: §3.3 defines conditional attribution-based scores and capping; Appendix A.4.2 addresses monitor calibration. Per-task eligible successful samples differ from the full benchmark size.
sourceMethods.zh: §3.3 定义条件归因分数和封顶；附录 A.4.2 讨论校准。各任务合格成功样本的分母不同于基准总实例数。

validity.en: Task designs create known decision factors; they do not cover all deployment failures. The input-intervention score depends on a meaningful treatment effect and the source’s attribution assumptions. Capping at one hides excess flagging from that endpoint, so calibration matters. Stress-test instructions and monitored message scope must accompany any result.
validity.zh: 设计提供已知决策因素，不覆盖所有部署失败。输入干预指标依赖有意义的处理效应及归因假设，封顶使额外标记不能体现在该终点中，因此需核查校准。压力提示和消息可见范围必须随结果保留。

usage.en: Model recommendation: select monitor access and a tolerable false-positive regime before comparison, preserve nominal controls, and test monitoring inside a defense protocol rather than treating visibility as safety.
usage.zh: 模型建议：先选择消息可见范围和可接受假阳性条件，保留原始输入对照，并在完整防御协议中测试监测。

unknowns: Each retained result still needs its own version, budget, attempt count, denominator and interval review before a matched comparison.

en.measurement: How sensitive are cyber-capability evaluations to elicitation and communication protocol?
en.task: 3CB evaluates fourteen models on fifteen challenges and eighty elicitation configurations, with four ethically withheld challenges retained privately.
en.scoring: Challenge completion under alternative elicitation protocols; not catastrophic-harm probability.
en.conditions: Fourteen models, fifteen challenges, eighty elicitation configurations.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: GPT-4o’s completion improved by 24.7 percentage points with XML versus JSON in the reported mixed-effects analysis (p<0.001). Other models showed different protocol sensitivity (§3.2).
en.validity: Challenge completion does not measure catastrophic outcomes; withheld tasks and finite challenge breadth limit public reproduction.
en.usage: Model recommendation: record protocol and elicitation configuration before interpreting model rankings or risk labels.

zh.validity: 题目完成不测灾难结果，保留任务与有限广度限制公开复现。

en.measurement: Can poisoned tool metadata redirect agents even without invoking the poisoned tool?
en.task: 1,348 test cases derive from 45 live MCP servers and 353 tools, using three human-defined attack paradigms and twenty agent settings.
en.scoring: Stealth-specific attack success; calling the poisoned tool directly is a failure.
en.conditions: 1,348 cases from 45 MCP servers/353 tools; three template paradigms.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: o1-mini’s reported attack success was 72.8%. Direct invocation of the poisoned tool is labeled failure in the stealth-specific scoring, not success (§4.1).
en.validity: Human-defined generic templates are not adaptive defense-specific attacks; scoring depends on the benchmark’s stealth criterion.
en.usage: Model recommendation: preserve metadata exposure and success definition when comparing with AgentDojo or InjecAgent.

zh.measurement: 不调用被污染工具时，其元数据能否仍劫持智能体？
zh.task: 45个实际MCP服务器、353工具构造1,348例，采用三类人工攻击范式，测20种智能体设置。
zh.scoring: 按隐蔽攻击成功计，直接调用污染工具为失败。
zh.conditions: 45服务器353工具构造1,348例，三类模板。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： o1-mini所报攻击成功72.8%。 按隐蔽判据直接调用污染工具被记为失败（§4.1）。
zh.validity: 人工通用模板不是针对防护自适应攻击，计分依赖隐蔽标准。
zh.usage: 模型建议：与AgentDojo、InjecAgent比较时保留元数据暴露及成功定义。

en.measurement: Can LLM judges distinguish objectively correct from incorrect sophisticated responses?
en.task: Difficult knowledge, reasoning, math and coding datasets are converted to labeled response pairs, with both presentation orders and explicit tie handling.
en.scoring: Correct preference for the objective correct answer across two orderings; inconsistent/two-tie results fail.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: Many strong judges, including GPT-4o, performed only slightly above random in the reported evaluation.
en.validity: Curated correct/incorrect pairs do not cover all open-ended evaluation qualities; pair construction and reference correctness still matter.
en.usage: Model recommendation: validate the judge on task-relevant difficult pairs and report order consistency.

en.measurement: Can activation-based group detectors generalize from known collusion to new scenarios?
en.task: Four open-weight models and six probe architectures use Core leave-domain-out tests, then Transfer/Stego tests with five aggregation techniques.
en.scoring: AUROC plus recall at specified FPR, with group-level aggregation.
en.conditions: Core leave-domain-out versus zero-shot Transfer/Stego; tuning visibility must be disclosed.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: Every model reached 1.00 in-distribution AUROC. On structural Transfer, the best reported method recalled only 0.38 at 1% FPR, despite stronger AUROC results.
en.validity: Synthetic collusion and small model coverage constrain generalization; appendix hyperparameters were selected using OOD mean AUROC, so tuning visibility matters.
en.usage: Model recommendation: report strict-threshold recall and separate tuning, training and held-out environments.

zh.measurement: 激活群体检测能否从已知合谋泛化到新场景？
zh.task: 四个开放模型、六种探针架构，在Core留域验证，再以五种聚合方法测Transfer与Stego。
zh.scoring: 群体聚合AUROC及指定误报率下召回。
zh.conditions: Core留域与Transfer/Stego迁移分开，披露调参可见性。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： 各模型分布内AUROC均1.00。 结构迁移上最佳方法在1%误报时召回仅0.38，尽管AUROC较高。
zh.validity: 合成合谋与少量模型限制泛化，附录使用OOD均值选超参数，须明确调参可见性。
zh.usage: 模型建议：报告严格阈值召回，并分开调参、训练与保留环境。

en.measurement: Do models reject unethical persuasion and avoid unethical strategies after accepting a task?

en.measurement: Will agents violate a specification to pass tests made deliberately impossible?
en.task: Tasks mutate LiveCodeBench and SWE-bench so tests conflict with the natural-language specification; passing such cases serves as a cheating proxy.
en.scoring: Pass rate on deliberately specification-conflicting impossible tests is a cheating proxy.
en.conditions: Mutated LiveCodeBench/SWE-bench; prompt/test access/feedback vary.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: Monitor detection was 86–89% on Impossible-LiveCodeBench but substantially lower on Impossible-SWEbench.
en.validity: Passing signals a specification violation only if the mutation is truly impossible; this rate does not estimate ordinary coding-task cheating.
en.usage: Model recommendation: verify impossibility and retain test access, prompt and feedback conditions.

zh.conditions: 变异LiveCodeBench和SWE-bench，改变提示测试访问与反馈。

zh.validity: 只有变异确实不可解，通过才证明违规；该比例不估计普通编程作弊率。
zh.usage: 模型建议：验证不可能性，并保留测试访问、提示和反馈条件。

en.measurement: Which evaluation cues trigger recognition, and does recognition change behavior?
en.task: Eight controlled factors vary across 100 paired safety/capability tasks; nine models and four earlier benchmarks provide additional ten-repeat tests.
en.scoring: Verbalized recognition and behavioral compliance are measured separately under paired cue interventions.
en.conditions: 100 paired tasks, eight factors; nine-model/four-benchmark earlier tests use ten repetitions.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: Some factors reduce capability-task performance without matching evaluation-awareness signals, indicating difficulty confounding (§4.2).
en.validity: Measurement targets verbalized recognition under black-box access; unspoken awareness and CoT unfaithfulness remain gaps (§5).
en.usage: Model recommendation: compare paired cue interventions and preserve non-awareness pathways before attributing score changes to evaluation gaming.

en.measurement: How well do multimodal models understand naturally occurring scientific charts?
en.task: 2,323 expert-curated arXiv charts support over 10,000 descriptive/reasoning questions, split into 1,000 validation charts and a held-answer test set.
en.scoring: Separate descriptive/reasoning accuracy; validation and held-answer test populations differ.
en.conditions: 2,323 charts; 1,000 validation charts and remainder for test.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: The paper reports GPT-4o reasoning accuracy of 47.1%. en.validity: Human errors and automated grading uncertainty limit ceiling claims; chart curation is expensive and scientific-paper coverage is selective.

zh.usage: 模型建议：区分描述与推理，以及验证与保留测试结果。

en.measurement: Can bioinformatics agents solve verifiable research questions that differ from exam-style biology?
en.task: Tasks have checkable answers but allow varied solution routes; up to five experts attempt each question, and model accuracy averages five trials per problem.
en.scoring: Accuracy averaged over five trials per problem; human-solvable and human-difficult subsets separate.
en.conditions: Up to five experts per task; 76 human-solvable and 23 retained human-difficult tasks.
en.statistics: Source-reported result statements; this does not establish trial counts, denominators or an estimator: 76 tasks were solved by at least one human. After removing four flawed questions, 23 remained human-difficult; Mythos Preview solved about 30% of that subset.
en.validity: Small selected subsets, expert recruitment and removed flawed questions constrain claims of human superiority; no wet-lab uplift is measured.
en.usage: Model recommendation: retain human-solvable/difficult definitions and five-trial averaging; omit operational biological task details.

zh.measurement: 生信智能体能否解决不同于考试题的可验证研究问题？

zh.scoring: 每题五次平均正确率，分人类可解与困难子集。
zh.conditions: 每题最多五专家，76可解及23保留困难题。
zh.statistics: 来源报告的结果表述；这不等同于已确定运行次数、分母或估计方法： 76题至少一位人类解决。 删除四道缺陷题后，23题仍为人类困难，Mythos Preview解其中约30%。
zh.validity: 小型筛选集、专家招募和删题限制超人类结论，未测湿实验增益。
zh.usage: 模型建议：保留子集定义与五次平均，省略操作性生物题目细节。

en.scoring: Separate detection recall, patch validation and programmatically verified exploit score.

en.usage: Model recommendation: cite mode and harness conditions; do not treat exploit scores as live-network compromise rates.

TraceProbe: An Execution-Based Benchmark for Diagnosing Safety Failures in LLM Agents

review.readingCoverage: selected-original-sections

measurement.en: Can execution traces identify safety violations that final outcomes miss?
measurement.zh: 终态安全是否掩盖中途违规？

task.en: The benchmark executes 155 sandbox scenarios spanning non-adversarial failures, internal-authority compromise and external attacks. Twelve models are run three times, totaling 5,580 executions. Repeats are averaged within scenario before averaging across eligible scenarios. ASR uses 105 attack-labeled scenarios; the other headline metrics use 155.
task.zh: 155 个可执行沙箱场景分为非对抗失效、内部权限受损和外部攻击。12 个模型各运行三次，共 5,580 次执行。指标先在场景内平均重复，再跨适用场景平均；ASR 只使用 105 个攻击标注场景，其余主指标使用 155 个场景。

scoring.en: TSR is utility-pass rate; SVR is endpoint safety-failure rate; ASR is that failure rate on attack-labeled scenarios; STCR requires task success without endpoint or latent violations. Latent violations are prohibited intermediate trace events. ASR uses 105 attack-labeled scenarios; the other headline metrics use 155. Each scenario averages three repeats.
scoring.zh: TSR 是任务通过率，SVR 是终点安全违规率，ASR 是攻击标注场景上的安全违规率；STCR 要求任务成功且无终点或中间违规。潜在违规指被禁止的中间轨迹事件。ASR 分母为 105 个攻击标注场景，其余主指标为 155；每场景先平均三次重复。

statistics.en: Retain per-metric population, repeats and interval definitions from the record evidence table. Missing event numerators remain unknown.
statistics.zh: 逐指标保留证据表的总体、重复和区间定义；未给出的事件分子保持未知。

conditions.en: Source-specific interfaces and constructed task conditions; this reading does not establish matched comparability with other protocols.
conditions.zh: 来源特定接口与构造任务条件；此次阅读不确立与其他协议的匹配可比性。

validity.en: The constructed distribution does not estimate natural incident prevalence. Appendix H bootstrap intervals describe scenario composition; the retained passage does not explicitly state their confidence level.
validity.zh: ASR 仅针对攻击标记子集；回放重执行既定工具调用，不重新运行模型，不能证明反事实因果。

usage.en: NUWA recommendation: Use the joint metrics and trace locations to compare intervention points within this source. Do not rank these values against unrelated cyber benchmarks.
usage.zh: NUWA 建议：新增过程证据层；保留主试验、配对提醒、压力测试和回放各自分母。

measurement.en: Can a manipulation policy complete its task while damaging its environment?

task.en: DamageSim adds damage signals to manipulation simulation and evaluates damage-aware policies in two simulation environments. Task completion and damage are interpreted jointly rather than reduced to success alone.

statistics.en: Numerical cell extraction is not included in this batch; sample and uncertainty fields remain unestablished.

conditions.en: Source-specific interfaces and constructed task conditions; this reading does not establish matched comparability with other protocols.

validity.en: Damage depends on simulator physics and thresholds. Simulation cost is neither human-harm probability nor complete coverage of real materials and contacts.

sourceRefs.version: Original resource captured 2026-10-28T07:24:44.372873+00:00; sha256:303708eaa7bcf2e1d96cd551279703949de0dff652b1b5b86e0cd2dd5905329a

review.readingCoverage: selected-original-sections

measurement.en: How do structural, language and visual perturbations affect embodied safety?
measurement.zh: 结构、语言、视觉变化分别如何影响具身安全？

task.en: The protocol covers 13 safety categories, 66 base scenarios and five embodiments. Language and visual variations overlay the base scenarios. Outcomes separate safe success, safe failure, unsafe success and unsafe failure, with cumulative safety cost and exposure measures.
task.zh: 协议覆盖 13 类安全问题、66 个基础场景和 5 种具身；语言与视觉变化叠加在基础场景上。结果区分安全成功、安全失败、不安全成功和不安全失败，并辅以累计安全成本与风险暴露指标。

scoring.en: Retain safe/unsafe success/failure and process-cost components. Language and visual overlays are not extra independent base scenarios.
scoring.zh: 保留安全／不安全成功与失败、过程成本分量。语言与视觉叠加条件不额外计为独立基础场景。

statistics.en: Retain per-metric population, repeats and interval definitions from the record evidence table. Missing event numerators remain unknown.
statistics.zh: 逐指标保留证据表的总体、重复和区间定义；未给出的事件分子保持未知。

conditions.en: Source-specific interfaces and constructed task conditions; this reading does not establish matched comparability with other protocols.
conditions.zh: 来源特定接口与构造任务条件；此次阅读不确立与其他协议的匹配可比性。

validity.en: Overlay variants are not additional independent base tasks. Results depend on simulation safety thresholds and the evaluated embodiments.
validity.zh: 语言和视觉变化叠加在基础场景上，不是另外新增的独立任务；指标依赖仿真安全阈值。

usage.en: NUWA recommendation: Compare safety components within a shared embodiment and configuration, preserving base-scenario and perturbation identities.
usage.zh: NUWA 建议：为物理安全页面补充过程指标，保留原始分量，避免只采用综合标量。

measurement.en: Sabotage, monitor detection and deployment control in software-engineering environments.
measurement.zh: 软件工程环境中的破坏、监测检出与部署控制。

task.en: 20 software environments pair legitimate engineering tasks with scored security side tasks, including running services and databases.
task.zh: 20个软件环境将合法工程任务与可判分的安全旁支任务配对，包括运行中的服务和数据库。

validity.en: Tasks deliberately place agents near security-critical resources. All28explicit labels in article images1–3 are transcribed; graphical interval type/endpoints and exact sabotage denominators are not disclosed. Pareto frontier coordinates are not digitized.
validity.zh: 任务刻意将智能体置于安全关键资源附近。图1–3的28个明确数值标签已转录；误差棒类型及端点、破坏实验的精确分母未披露。帕累托曲线坐标尚未数字化。

scoring.en: Sabotage means causing harm without being caught; safety means detection before harm. Usefulness is the proportion of main tasks solved.
scoring.zh: 破坏指标指造成损害且未被发现；安全性指损害发生前检测成功；实用性指完成的主任务比例。

conditions.en: Article evaluates Opus4.6 attacks against GPT-5 Nano monitoring at1% action-level FPR, with separate baseline, strategy-augmented and human-crafted attacks.
conditions.zh: 文章在逐动作误报率1%下以GPT-5 Nano监测Opus4.6攻击，区分基线、策略增强和人工构造攻击。

measurement.en: Safety/usefulness tradeoffs for trusted control of untrusted system-administration agents.
measurement.zh: 可信控制方案对不可信系统管理智能体的安全性与实用性权衡。

task.en: 637 main tasks across nine clusters are paired with four scored security side tasks.
task.zh: 637项主任务分属九类，与四类有明确判分的安全旁支任务配对。

validity.en: Weak integration of dangerous permissions and difficult test cases allows sandboxing shortcuts. Dynamic permission management is banned in the control game; results do not assess that class of protocols.
validity.zh: 危险权限与困难测试用例结合不充分，允许沙箱化捷径。控制博弈禁止动态权限管理，因此结果不评估这类方案。

scoring.en: Safety is detecting an attack before it succeeds. Usefulness uses average fraction of main-task test cases passed, not all-or-nothing task success.
scoring.zh: 安全性指在攻击成功前检测到攻击；实用性按主任务测试用例平均通过比例计算，不是整项任务全部通过率。

conditions.en: Original release evaluates trusted monitoring at 4% trajectory-wise FPR; a prose example gives74% safety with GPT-4.1 mini. Sonnet4.5 and GPT-4.1 mini use all637 tasks, other models random100-task subsets.
conditions.zh: 初版在轨迹误报率4%下评测可信监测；正文例子给出GPT-4.1 mini安全性74%。Sonnet4.5和GPT-4.1 mini使用全部637任务，其他模型用随机100题子集。

protocols.name: Agent Security Bench (ASB): Formalizing and Benchmarking Attacks and Defenses in LLM-based Agents

measurement.en: Attack and defense failure modes across agent prompts, tool responses and memory.
measurement.zh: 智能体提示、工具响应与记忆中的攻击和防御失效。

task.en: Ten scenario-specific agents carry out tool-using tasks. Direct/indirect prompt injection, memory poisoning, mixed attacks and plan-of-thought backdoors are separate conditions.
task.zh: 十类场景的智能体执行工具任务；直接／间接提示注入、记忆投毒、混合攻击与思维计划后门分别作为条件。

validity.en: Table 6 reuses ASR from Table 5 and PNA from Table 19, rather than new runs. Proprietary-model parameter estimates in Table 13 are not adopted as model-size evidence.
validity.zh: Table 6 重用 Table 5 的 ASR 和 Table 19 的 PNA，不作为新运行。Table 13 的闭源模型参数估计不用于模型尺寸编码。

scoring.en: ASR counts attacked tasks in which attack-specific tools are used; RR measures refusal. PNA measures normal task completion. These metrics and their aggregates remain separate.
scoring.zh: ASR 按被攻击任务中使用攻击工具的比例计算；RR 测量拒绝，PNA 测量正常任务完成。各指标及其聚合分别保留。

conditions.en: ASB uses a ReAct framework based on AIOS. The paper reports 13 LLM backbones. Appendix C.2.2 describes memory retrieval through Chroma; per-condition tool/attack settings are retained with each observation.
conditions.zh: ASB 采用基于 AIOS 的 ReAct 框架，报告 13 种基础模型。附录 C.2.2 说明基于 Chroma 的记忆检索；每条观测保留具体攻击和工具条件。

protocols.name: SafeAgentBench: A Benchmark for Safe Task Planning of Embodied LLM Agents

measurement.en: Safety-aware embodied task planning, separating refusal, risky execution and safe completion.
measurement.zh: 具身任务规划的安全表现，区分拒绝、风险执行与安全完成。

task.en: SafeAgentBench contains 750 simulated embodied tasks, including 450 hazardous and 300 paired safe tasks. Detailed, abstract and long-horizon tasks test different planning demands.
task.zh: 包含 750 项模拟具身任务，其中 450 项有危险、300 项为对应安全任务；详细、抽象与长时程任务分别测量不同规划要求。

validity.en: Simulator task performance does not establish real-world physical incident frequency. Task type, evaluator and agent design change the meaning of each reported ratio.
validity.zh: 模拟器任务结果不能直接解释为现实物理事件频率；任务类型、判分方式和智能体设计都会改变比例含义。

scoring.en: Detailed tasks report rejection, goal-based/LLM-based risk ratios and execution; abstract tasks report rejection and risk ratios; long-horizon tasks distinguish completed-safe, completed-unsafe and incomplete. Source ratios are retained on their original 0–1 scale.
scoring.zh: 详细任务报告拒绝率、基于目标／LLM 的风险率及执行率；抽象任务报告拒绝与风险率；长时程区分安全完成、不安全完成与未完成。比例保留原文 0–1 尺度。

conditions.en: Baseline agents are adapted to SafeAgentEnv. Appendix C.1 specifies temperature 0 and max_tokens 4096; Appendix C.2 lists 17 high-level actions. GPT-4 main results and three open-model appendix results are separate conditions.
conditions.zh: 各基线适配到 SafeAgentEnv。附录 C.1 设置 temperature=0、max_tokens=4096，C.2 列出 17 项高层动作；GPT-4 主表与三种开源模型附录结果分别保留。

protocols.name: Identifying the Risks of LM Agents with an LM-Emulated Sandbox

measurement.en: Agent safety and helpfulness in a language-model-emulated tool sandbox.
measurement.zh: 语言模型模拟工具沙箱中的智能体安全性与帮助性。

task.en: ToolEmu emulates tool executions and evaluates agent trajectories. Standard and adversarial emulators are separately validated; main agent results use the adversarial setup.
task.zh: ToolEmu 模拟工具执行并评估智能体轨迹，分别验证标准与对抗模拟器；主要智能体结果采用对抗设置。

validity.en: Table 3 margins are one standard error. Table 5 footnote gives estimated standard errors across three independent runs; they are not per-cell confidence intervals. Emulator failures and evaluator errors must be considered alongside agent scores.
validity.zh: Table 3 的误差为一个标准误。Table 5 脚注给出三次独立运行估计的标准误，不视为逐单元置信区间。解读智能体成绩时还需考虑模拟与判分误差。

scoring.en: Agent safety and helpfulness averages use 0–3 scores. Failure incidence reports the proportion of test cases flagged as failures. Validation precision and true failure incidence are separate measurement-validation statistics.
scoring.zh: 智能体安全性和帮助性采用 0–3 平均分；失败发生率是被判为失败的测试比例。验证精度与真实失败发生率属于独立的测量验证统计。

conditions.en: The main evaluation sets temperature to 0 for agents, emulators and evaluators, comparing Basic, Safety and Helpful+Safety prompts. The NoAct baseline takes no actions.
conditions.zh: 主要实验对智能体、模拟器和评估器均设置 temperature=0，比较 Basic、Safety、Helpful+Safety 提示；NoAct 基线不执行行动。

protocols.name: Tensor Trust: Interpretable Prompt Injection Attacks from an Online Game

measurement.en: Prompt hijacking/extraction robustness and defense validity.
measurement.zh: 提示劫持／提取鲁棒性及防御有效性。

task.en: A crowdsourced access-code game supplies adversarial attacks and defenses. Held-out evaluation tests model robustness against selected attacks.
task.zh: 众包访问口令游戏产生攻击与防御，使用筛选出的攻击评测模型鲁棒性。

validity.en: Higher robustness is better. Reference models participated in filtering, and defense validity must be interpreted jointly with robustness.
validity.zh: 鲁棒性越高越好。参考模型参与筛选，解读时需将防御有效性与鲁棒性一并考虑。

scoring.en: HRR is the percentage of hijacking attacks that fail; ERR is the percentage of extraction attacks not revealing the exact access code. Defense validity measures correct access when the true code is supplied.
scoring.zh: HRR 是劫持攻击失败比例，ERR 是未泄露精确口令的提取攻击比例，防御有效性衡量提供真口令时是否正确授权。

conditions.en: Tables A1/A2 distinguish attacks and defenses filtered using the first three reference models; model snapshots are retained verbatim.
conditions.zh: Table A1/A2 的前三个参考模型参与攻击和防御筛选，具体模型快照按原文保留。

sourceRefs.version: fb1e829e9a35db2f01567c1b0e3bfcdbb34ff68c7e005bab5c99097c99991c35

protocols.name: RedCode: Risky Code Execution and Generation Benchmark for Code Agents

measurement.en: Unsafe code execution and explicitly harmful code generation under distinct protocols.
measurement.zh: 分别评测不安全代码执行与明确有害的代码生成。

task.en: RedCode-Exec contains 4,050 test cases spanning code and text forms; RedCode-Gen contains 160 function-signature/docstring prompts across eight software categories.
task.zh: RedCode-Exec 包含代码与文本形式的 4,050 项测试；RedCode-Gen 包含八类软件的 160 项函数签名与说明提示。

validity.en: Exec and Gen are different measurements and are not averaged. Numeric figures remain queued for explicit data acquisition or digitization; this table extraction is not full benchmark data coverage.
validity.zh: Exec 与 Gen 测量不同，不做平均。数值图仍待取得底层数据或明确数字化；本轮表格提取不表示已覆盖全部 Benchmark 数据。

scoring.en: Exec uses execution scripts to distinguish rejection, execution failure and attack success. Gen reports refusal, generated-code accuracy and a separate VirusTotal score. The latter retains its source label because its unit has not been established here.
scoring.zh: Exec 通过执行脚本区分拒绝、执行失败与攻击成功。Gen 报告拒绝、代码准确性和独立的 VirusTotal 分数；后者在本轮未确定单位，保留来源标签。

conditions.en: Base models and code agents are separate systems. For the ReAct mitigation table, Appendix C.2 specifies temperature 0, up to 1024 generated tokens and eight interaction rounds.
conditions.zh: 基础模型与代码智能体分别作为系统。ReAct 缓解实验对应附录 C.2：temperature=0、最多生成 1024 tokens、八轮交互。

heading.en: Longer tasks, a narrower measurement margin
heading.zh: 长程能力上移，测量边界趋近

analysis.en: METR 1.1 reports a 50% task horizon of 3.99 minutes for GPT-4 and 718.81 minutes for Claude Opus 4.6, with a source-reported 95% interval of 316.69–3,633.79 minutes for the latter. These estimates describe human-expert task duration, not continuous agent runtime. The original time-horizon paper explains thresholding, human calibration and the fitted success curve; the live 1.1 series is separately versioned. RepliBench and shutdown tests add component and intervention evidence, but there is no common end-to-end outcome linking these studies.
analysis.zh: METR 1.1 报告 GPT-4 的 50% 任务跨度为 3.99 分钟、Claude Opus 4.6 为 718.81 分钟，后者原文 95% 区间为 316.69–3,633.79 分钟。估计描述人类专家任务时长，并非智能体连续运行时间。原始跨度论文解释阈值、人类校准和拟合曲线；实时 1.1 序列是独立版本。RepliBench 与关机测试补充组件和干预证据，但这些研究没有共同的端到端终点。

takeaway.en: Long-horizon capability has advanced within METR’s task distribution. Tracking the frontier now also requires extending the measurement range and linking control tests to the same systems.
takeaway.zh: 在 METR 的任务分布内，长程能力已明显提升；继续追踪前沿还需要扩展测量范围，并将控制实验关联到相同系统。

limits.en: Task-completion, replication and shutdown studies measure different links in autonomy research. Their results cannot be combined into a loss-of-control probability.
limits.zh: 任务完成、复制与关机研究测量自主性问题的不同环节，其结果不能合并为失控概率。

nextCheck.en: Measure task completion and response to intervention on the same model, configuration and task distribution; identify absent joint measurements before planning experiments.
nextCheck.zh: 先查明同一模型、配置和任务分布中任务完成与干预响应的联合测量缺口，再规划实验。

heading.en: Pressure responses depend on the goal and threat
heading.zh: 压力响应随目标与威胁条件变化

analysis.en: SaferAI reports 108 condition cells from three models, three scenarios, four goal conditions and three threat conditions, with 30 rollouts per cell. NUWA counts 103 zero cells and five non-zero cells; all five non-zero cells concern GLM-5.2 blackmail. Across the entire blackmail set the range is 0–57%, including 31 zero cells out of 36. Among non-zero cells only, the printed rates range from 3% to 57%. These are different summaries of the same matrix, not contradictory ranges. The printed intervals remain source-reported with an unspecified confidence level.
analysis.zh: SaferAI 报告三个模型、三个情境、四种目标条件和三种威胁条件，共 108 个条件单元，每单元 30 次试验。NUWA 计数为 103 个零值和 5 个非零值；全部非零值均为 GLM-5.2 勒索条件。完整勒索集合范围为 0–57%，36 个单元中有 31 个零值；仅非零单元的报告范围才是 3–57%。两种摘要针对同一矩阵的不同子集，并不矛盾。原文区间保留为来源报告，置信水平未明确。

takeaway.en: Monitor harmful actions by goal and threat condition. The observed concentration in particular blackmail conditions is more informative than an average across unrelated scenarios.
takeaway.zh: 应按目标与威胁条件监测有害行动；特定勒索条件中的集中表现，比跨不同情境的平均值更有解释力。

limits.en: These are controlled simulations with 30 rollouts per cell. The findings describe the tested configurations, not deployed-event frequencies. The source’s printed intervals are retained without inferring an unstated confidence level.
limits.zh: 这是每单元 30 次试验的受控模拟，结论针对受测配置，不是部署事件发生频率。保留原文印出的区间，不推断未注明的置信水平。

nextCheck.en: Repeat the same goal–threat cells on later model versions with the same task setup and judge, while separately testing whether interventions stop the action.
nextCheck.zh: 在相同任务设置与判别器下，对后续模型版本复测同一目标—威胁单元，并独立测试干预能否中止行动。

title.en: Non-zero actions cluster in one scenario
title.zh: 非零行动集中于一个情境

body.en: Across all 108 condition cells, 103 are zero and five are non-zero. All five non-zero cells are GLM-5.2 blackmail conditions. The counts are NUWA calculations from the complete matrix.

heading.en: Compute budget changes the cyber capability observed
heading.zh: 推理预算改变可观察的网络能力

analysis.en: SaferAI’s report describes CyberGym as vulnerability reproduction and selects hard Level 1 tasks following Lyptus. It starts from a 122-task sample and retains 101 tasks with available comparison data. Its source prose reports GLM-5.2 success rising from 36.6% at 2M tokens to 76.2% at 50M; the extracted condition records retain their own printed precision. SaferAI executed the GLM runs, while the GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.6 comparison values were calculated from Lyptus data. Shared task identity does not erase execution differences. The source’s overlapping Wilson intervals do not prove equivalence.
analysis.zh: SaferAI 将 CyberGym 定义为漏洞复现，并按 Lyptus 方法选择 Level 1 困难任务：从 122 项样本中保留具有比较数据的 101 项。来源正文报告 GLM-5.2 成功率从 2M token 时的 36.6% 升至 50M 时的 76.2%，条件记录保留各自印出的精度。GLM 运行由 SaferAI 执行，GPT-5.5 与 Opus 4.6 比较值由 Lyptus 数据计算。任务身份相同不能消除执行差异，Wilson 区间重叠也不能证明等效。

takeaway.en: Monitor model capability together with task scope and inference resources. A higher observed result can reflect a different budget or harness as well as a different model.
takeaway.zh: 监测模型能力时应同时追踪任务范围与推理资源；更高的观测结果可能来自预算、Harness 或模型本身的变化。

limits.en: Source reports overlapping 95% Wilson intervals; exact endpoints are not transcribed because the figure does not print them. This is a task-matched descriptive comparison, not a strict matched model ranking.
limits.zh: 来源报告 95% Wilson 区间存在重叠；图中未印出精确端点，因此不转录端点。本图是任务匹配的描述性比较，不构成严格条件匹配的模型排名。

nextCheck.en: Resolve protocol fields across reports first. Use matched comparisons only after verifying model identity, task version, attempts, scaffold and budget.
nextCheck.zh: 先解析不同报告的协议字段；核实模型身份、任务版本、尝试次数、脚手架和预算后，再开展条件匹配比较。

title.en: The same model changes substantially with budget
title.zh: 同一模型的预算差异较大

body.en: SaferAI reports GLM-5.2 CyberGym reproduction rates of 36.6% at 2M tokens and 76.2% at 50M tokens on its hard-task subset.
body.zh: SaferAI 报告，在其 CyberGym 困难任务子集中，GLM-5.2 的漏洞复现率从 2M token 时的 36.6% 增至 50M token 时的 76.2%。

heading.en: Do observed persuasion attempts and safety responses change across models under the same protocol?
heading.zh: 同一协议下，不同模型的说服尝试与安全响应呈现何种差异？

analysis.en: Neo reports medium-harm attempt rates of 54% for GLM-5.2, 57% for Claude Sonnet 5 and 76% for DeepSeek V4 Pro in its adapted PersuSafety evaluation. The adaptation judges ordinary free-form responses rather than asking the original binary willingness question. Its figures therefore describe a specific response-generation protocol. Source limitations include differing Claude reference versions across benchmarks, undisclosed execution details and no sustained multi-turn deployment evaluation. The collection also lacks a resolved Sonnet 5 release date, so these points do not establish a release-time trend.
analysis.zh: Neo 在改造 PersuSafety 中报告 GLM-5.2、Claude Sonnet 5 和 DeepSeek V4 Pro 中等危害尝试率分别为 54%、57% 和 76%。该改造判别普通自由生成回答，而非询问原协议的二元参与意愿；图表因此描述特定生成协议。限制包括跨基准使用不同 Claude 参考版本、部分执行细节未披露，以及未测试持续多轮部署。目录中 Sonnet 5 发布日期也未确定，因此这些点不能确立随发布时间变化的趋势。

takeaway.en: Keep generation behavior, willingness and downstream persuasion separate. The present snapshot supports tracking protocol-specific response differences, not an established time trend in societal manipulation risk.
takeaway.zh: 应分别追踪生成行为、参与意愿与后续说服效果。当前快照支持监测特定协议下的回答差异，尚不支持社会操纵风险的既定时间趋势。

limits.en: Willingness or simulated dialogue scores do not directly measure changes in human beliefs.
limits.zh: 参与意愿或模拟对话评分不直接测量人的信念变化。

nextCheck.en: Separate willingness, attempted persuasion and measured human response, then determine which common protocol can support model monitoring.
nextCheck.zh: 区分参与意愿、说服尝试与实测人类响应，再确认能够支撑模型监测的共同协议。

title.zh: 自由生成不同于参与意愿

body.en: The adapted PersuSafety endpoint reports medium-harm attempt rates of 54%, 57% and 76% for the three named models. Neo replaces the original direct willingness question with judging normal generated responses.
body.zh: 改造 PersuSafety 对三个具名模型报告中等危害尝试率 54%、57% 和 76%；Neo 用普通回答判别替代原协议的直接参与意愿提问。

heading.en: From visible reasoning to a defensible safety argument
heading.zh: 从可见推理到可辩护的安全论证

analysis.en: MonitorBench tests whether known decision-critical factors are visible under specified message access and stress conditions. AI Control tests defenses against adaptive intentional subversion and evaluates the safety/usefulness tradeoff of the complete protocol. Safety Cases then asks for an explicit argument connecting system-specific evidence and assumptions to an operating-context claim. The Misuse Safety Case illustrates one such chain: red-team effort curves, a risk model, continuing evaluation and response commitments. These sources do not establish that a high visibility score certifies deployment safety, or that a control result covers external misuse pathways.
analysis.zh: MonitorBench 检验指定消息可见范围及压力条件下的已知决策因素是否可见。AI Control 面对适应性的蓄意破坏，衡量完整协议的安全性与有用性。Safety Cases 则要求显式连接系统证据、假设与运行情境主张。Misuse Safety Case 提供一条示例推理链：红队投入曲线、风险模型、持续评测与响应承诺。这些来源不能证明高可见性分数就是部署安全认证，也不能证明控制结果覆盖外部滥用路径。

takeaway.en: Monitoring produces evidence; a control protocol acts on it; a safety case explains why that protocol and its assumptions support a defined decision. Success at one layer does not establish the next.
takeaway.zh: 监测产生证据，控制协议据此采取行动，安全案例解释协议与假设为何支持特定决策。一个层级成功不能自动证明下一层级成立。

limits.en: The monitoring tasks have known constructed factors; the control game has unusually reliable audits and a narrow threat model; the safety-case examples are methodological or hypothetical. Their uncertainties accumulate unless the linking assumptions are separately justified. No joint deployment experiment or empirical certification is claimed.
limits.zh: 监测任务提供已知构造因素，控制博弈采用格外可靠的审计和较窄威胁模型，安全案例属于方法或假设示例。除非独立论证连接假设，不确定性会累积。没有共同部署实验或实证认证。

nextCheck.en: Model recommendation: specify the forbidden outcome, trace which monitor signals trigger which intervention, test audit and response failures, and attach each assumption and defeater to its source version. Keep the deployment decision assigned to an authorized human decision-maker.
nextCheck.zh: 模型建议：定义禁止结果，追踪哪些监测信号触发何种干预，测试审计及响应失败，并把每个假设和反驳条件绑定来源版本。部署决策仍由获授权的人类决策者承担。

title.zh: 可见性是有条件的证据

body.en: MonitorBench separates verification, intervention attribution and monitor flags; concealment effects vary by task and message scope.
body.zh: MonitorBench 区分验收、干预归因和监测标记；隐瞒影响随任务与消息范围变化。

title.en: The complete defense determines the outcome

body.en: AI Control combines monitoring with audits, routing and fallback; naive untrusted monitoring can fail even when a monitor has the ability to recognize a problem.
body.zh: AI Control 将监测与审计、路由和回退结合；即便监测者具备识别问题能力，朴素不可信监测仍可失败。

en.question: Can models undermine decisions, code and oversight?
en.design: Four adversarial evaluations, including a human business-decision experiment and attacker–defender code review.
en.findings: Aggressive decision sabotage increased errors and suspicion; stronger code reviewers reduced attacker success.
en.limits: Small artificial scenarios measure elicited capability, not deployment prevalence.

zh.question: 模型能否破坏决策、代码和监督？
zh.design: 四类对抗评测，包括人类商业决策实验及攻击者—防守者代码审查。
zh.findings: 激进干预增加决策错误，也增加怀疑；更强代码审查模型降低攻击成功。
zh.limits: 小规模人工情境测量被诱发的能力，不能估计部署发生率。

publications.title: How we monitor internal coding agents for misalignment
publications.scope: Selected original webpage sections; linked paper, appendix and data not fully audited.

en.question: What can deployment monitoring reveal about coding-agent misalignment?
en.design: A model reviews reasoning and actions, triaging suspicious trajectories for humans.
en.findings: It caught all known employee escalations and additional issues; the report found no highest-severity real conversations.
en.limits: Recall against reported incidents cannot establish the false-negative rate for unknown subtle failures.

zh.question: 部署监测能揭示哪些编程智能体失准行为？
zh.design: 模型审查推理与动作，并将可疑轨迹分流给人工。
zh.findings: 监测覆盖已知员工上报并发现额外问题；报告未发现最高严重度的真实会话。
zh.limits: 对已上报事件的召回不能证明对未知隐蔽失败的漏报率。

publications.title: Findings from a pilot Anthropic–OpenAI alignment evaluation exercise: OpenAI Safety Tests
publications.scope: Web-tool rendered extract captured through line399; introduction and summary selected. Detailed later grader-error section not captured/read in this extraction; linked full evaluation appendix not audited.

en.question: What failures appear when another vendor runs its own safety tests?
en.design: OpenAI tested Claude and its own models on instruction hierarchy, jailbreaks, hallucination and scheming, with some external safeguards relaxed.
en.findings: The introductory summary reports task- and reasoning-dependent results and notes that grader errors affected one jailbreak comparison.
en.limits: The authors explicitly reject exact apples-to-apples comparisons and deployment-frequency interpretations.

zh.question: 另一厂商运行自有安全测试会发现哪些失败？
zh.design: OpenAI 在指令层级、越狱、幻觉和策略性隐瞒任务上测试 Claude 与自家模型，并放宽部分外部防护。
zh.findings: 引言摘要报告表现随任务和推理设置变化，并指出判分错误影响一项越狱比较。
zh.limits: 作者明确不将这些结果视为严格同条件比较或部署发生率。
